short_description: Duotone Grip (Tri) is a wave windsurfing board built in FULL CUSTOM PVC-WOOD technology and designed with our exclusive AI_BOARD_3D software. With its tri-fin setup it combines stability and easy handling in white water with radical turns on the wave. Aimed at intermediate to advanced riders, it works best in European wave conditions and logo-high swell.
description:
The Grip (Tri) was developed as a World Cup Wave board, but with a shape that ensures an exceptionally wide range of use. Thanks to the FULL CUSTOM PVC-WOOD construction, it offers a highly efficient strength-to-weight ratio while being more price-accessible than the D/LAB range.

Compared to standard wave boards, it is 1–2 cm wider, giving stability and flotation comparable to a board 5 liters bigger. At the same time, the increased outline curve allows it to turn as radical as a board 5 liters smaller. The segmented 3-stage rocker makes both bottom and top turns easier, combining a flat mid-section for stability with a progressive tail kick that allows tight top turns and instant acceleration.

The Synced Curves Concept aligns the outline, rocker and rails so the board reacts naturally and predictably in every maneuver. While the Grip (Tri) is versatile, its sweet spot remains European waves and logo-high groundswell – ideal for spots like Klitmøller, the Canary Islands, the North Sea or Kanaha.

page_title: Windsurf board JP-Australia Magic Move WOOD PRO 2026 - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Windsurf board JP-Australia Magic Move WOOD PRO 2026
short_description: FREEMOVE / FREERIDE The JP-Australia Magic Move is a sporty freemove board designed for riders looking for a fast, playful and early-planing shape in the 90 to 110 L range. It delivers a lively ride with excellent speed, smooth carving and impressive control. As the new 'Master of the Carve' in the JP lineup, it excels in aggressive jibes, small swell riding and high-wind freeride conditions. The Magic Move sits next to the Freestyle Wave as its powerful, more freeride-oriented sibling.
description:
Board character

Magic Move blends the best elements of small freeride and Freestyle Wave shapes. It planes earlier than the Freestyle Wave and carries speed more easily through manoeuvres. The wider tail improves efficiency in gusty conditions and helps maintain momentum, while the board remains loose, manoeuvrable and fun in swell. It is stable, fast and effortless to control, making it ideal for playful, sporty sessions on both flat water and coastal spots.

Construction

The Magic Move features a reinforced Carbon Innegra structure with a parabolic rail band and integrated Innegra nose protection. A full paulownia wood bottom sandwich increases stiffness and strength while keeping the board reactive and lightweight. The result is a tough, direct-feeling construction that supports high-speed carving and dynamic freeride performance.

Shape and details

Compared to the Freestyle Wave, the Magic Move is slightly longer and wider, with a noticeably broader tail to improve early planing and stability. A parallel mid-outline offers a large planing surface, while the even volume distribution helps the board lift onto the plane effortlessly with minimal pumping.

A key design feature is the updated rail shape: the raised apex in the mid-section provides extra lift during jibes, helping maintain speed and exit the turn with power. Towards the tail, the rail tapers into a defined step rail, allowing a wide tail to deliver grip and bite in tight turns without catching.

The flat scoop rocker supports fast acceleration and efficient planing. A pronounced double concave V in the nose works like suspension in chop, while the reduced V in the strap area and increased V again towards the tail enhance the blend of speed, manoeuvrability and control.

On the water

Magic Move is fast, stable and highly predictable. It pops onto the plane quickly, carries speed naturally through jibes and feels smooth and composed even in rough water. The board’s lively character makes carving fun and dynamic, while its stability and comfort make it ideal for long, high-wind sessions. Whether blasting or carving through small swell, the Magic Move feels energetic and well-balanced.

Who it's for

Perfect for intermediate to advanced riders who want a sporty, manoeuvrable freeride board that is more versatile than a typical freeride shape and easier than a pure wave board. It is an excellent choice for lake sailing, coastal bump and jump, carving jibes and dynamic high-wind freeriding.

page_title: Unifiber Alloy Ergo Boom - HD V-grip - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Unifiber Alloy Ergo Boom - HD V-grip
short_description: Unifiber HD Alloy V-Grip Boom - Ergo Head is an aluminium windsurfing boom for freeride and freerace, available in 140-190 and 200-250 cm sizes. The 26 x 33 mm V-Grip profile helps reduce forearm fatigue, while the reinforced HD construction provides high stiffness under load.
description:
V-Grip for comfortable longer sessions

The Unifiber HD Alloy V-Grip Boom - Ergo Head features a distinctive V-shaped tube profile designed to follow the natural position of the fingers and palm. This allows a more relaxed hold and can help reduce forearm strain during longer sessions.

The grip measures 26 x 33 mm. Its slim 26 mm dimension makes the boom easier to hold, while the V-shaped profile adds structural integrity and provides more direct feedback from the sail.

This combination is aimed primarily at freeride and freerace sailors who spend long periods in the harness and value both comfort and precise sail control.

The V-Grip feels noticeably different from a conventional round boom, so whether it suits your preferred hand position will ultimately depend on personal preference.

Reinforced HD T8 aluminium construction

The boom body is made from T8 aluminium with 1.7 mm tube walls. The increased wall thickness of the HD construction provides greater stiffness and durability compared with standard aluminium booms.

The arm geometry is designed to minimise deflection under load. Combined with the V-Grip profile, this results in a rigid construction and more direct power transfer between the rider and sail.

The additional material also makes HD models heavier than Essentials Alloy booms, but the trade-off is increased stiffness and durability for more demanding sailing.

Ergo Boom Head

The boom is equipped with the Ergo Boom Head and its classic single-hinge lever. The system is straightforward to operate and allows the boom to be attached to the mast quickly.

The boom head provides axial movement, helping it align correctly with the boom position on the mast. RDM and SDM adapters are included, allowing correct fitting to both common mast diameters.

Two sizes for different sail ranges

The 140-190 cm version has a maximum inner body width of 38 cm and a 12 cm inner tail width. Its body uses a C-shape profile and the tail features the Loop & Go system for quick and simple outhaul attachment.

This size is particularly suitable for smaller and medium-sized freeride and freerace sails.

The 200-250 cm version is designed for larger sails with deeper profiles. Its maximum inner body width increases to 49 cm, while the inner tail width is 18 cm. The extra clearance helps prevent the boom from interfering with the sail profile and allows larger sails to maintain their intended shape.

The 200-250 cm version uses a pulley tail system, making it easier to apply and fine-tune outhaul tension when dealing with the higher loads generated by larger freeride and freerace sails.

Stable length adjustment

Both versions use Double Pin Locks mounted on the boom body. The two pins securely lock the tail at the selected length and help minimise unwanted movement under load.

The tail tube diameter is 22.5 mm on both sizes.

Durable finish

High-density EVA is used around the front grip section to improve abrasion resistance in areas exposed to frequent wear.

The anodised tail improves corrosion resistance and long-term durability, particularly for riders who regularly sail in salt water.

Inlaid & Embossed grip graphics are integrated into the grip surface rather than relying only on a conventional surface print, improving resistance to wear.

page_title: Windsurf rig Gaastra Hybrid 2026 - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Windsurf rig Gaastra Hybrid 2026
short_description: WAVE / BUMP & JUMP / FREERIDE GA Sails Hybrid Rig 2026 is a complete windsurfing rig including the Hybrid 2026 sail, mast, boom, extension, uphaul, and a storage bag. The sail’s character changes depending on the selected size - from maneuverable wave performance, through versatile bump & jump use, to stable freeride riding. It is a practical setup for recreational and intermediate windsurfers looking for a matched rig that is ready to assemble
description:
A complete windsurfing rig

The GA Sails Hybrid Rig 2026 includes all the essential components needed to prepare a full windsurfing rig: the Hybrid 2026 sail, a GA 30% Carbon mast, an aluminium boom, an aluminium extension, an uphaul, and a storage bag for the complete set. Each component is matched to the selected sail size, so there is no need to choose the mast, boom, and extension separately.

This package is a practical choice for windsurfers who want one complete rig for recreational sailing, further progression, and regular use. The included bag makes it easier to store and transport all components together.

A character matched to each size

The Hybrid 2026 does not have the same behavior across its entire size range. Each version has been designed around the conditions in which it is most likely to be used.

The 4.7 has four battens and the most maneuverable character in the available rig range. It is intended for wave sailing, stronger wind, and conditions where control and easy handling through maneuvers matter most.

Sizes from 5.2 to 6.4 use five battens. They combine maneuverability with a more stable profile and work well for bump & jump sailing and versatile freeride use in choppy conditions.

The 6.7 and 7.2 sizes use six battens and are more freeride-oriented. They provide steadier power, good performance across the reach, and greater comfort during faster sailing on flat or lightly choppy water.

Smooth and predictable power delivery

A Dacron panel positioned alongside the mast sleeve helps the sail build power smoothly. This makes the rig less abrupt in gusts and easier to control in uneven wind.

The no-cam design supports smooth profile rotation during maneuvers and keeps rigging straightforward. The Hybrid offers clear but accessible feedback, allowing riders to develop their technique without moving to a more demanding race sail.

Progressive batten configuration

The reduced batten count in the smaller versions supports low weight and maneuverability. The larger sails use a more developed structure to maintain a stable profile during faster sailing and in the upper part of their wind range.

Hybrid 2026 construction

The one-piece mast sleeve reduces weight and improves the connection between the sail and mast. Compact Window Design provides good visibility while limiting unnecessary seams and transitions between different materials.

Sizes up to 6.4 use a durable X-Ply window. This is a practical solution for the smaller, more maneuver-oriented versions that are more likely to be used in waves and choppy conditions.

GA 30% Carbon mast

The rig includes a GA mast with 30% carbon content. It provides the response needed to work correctly with the sail profile while remaining focused on durability and recreational use.

Sizes up to 6.7 are supplied with an RDM mast. The 7.2 version uses an SDM mast suited to the larger sail area and its freeride-oriented character.

Aluminium boom

The rig includes an adjustable GA Sails aluminium boom. It offers durable construction, straightforward handling, and suitable stiffness for recreational and intermediate windsurfing.

The smaller sizes use a 140-190 cm boom, while the larger versions come with a 170-220 cm boom. The adjustment range also allows the boom to be used with other sails that fit within the specified dimensions.

Extension, uphaul, and storage bag

A 35 cm aluminium extension is included and matched in diameter to the mast supplied with the selected rig size. It allows the correct luff length to be set and the sail to be properly tensioned.

The package also includes an uphaul and a bag designed to hold the rig components. This makes it easier to keep the full set together during transport and storage.

Color options

The Hybrid 2026 sail is available in red and white color versions. Availability may depend on sail size and current stock, so the selected color should be confirmed with the shop before purchase.

Action photos may show the sail used with a different mast, boom, or extension than the components included in the complete rig.

page_title: DAKINE Cobra Half Hook Footstrap Florida Blue - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: DAKINE Cobra Half Hook Footstrap Florida Blue
short_description: Dakine Cobra is a single half hook for wing foil, windsurf foil and other strap-ready boards, designed to help stabilise your foot without fully locking it into a traditional strap. Its ergonomic shape, injection-moulded HDPE construction and soft foam/neoprene padding give you support, comfort and quick foot release when needed.
description:
Half hook for better board control

Dakine Cobra Half Hook OS is an alternative to a classic footstrap, made for riders who want more board control without having the foot fully enclosed. The hook helps keep your foot in a repeatable position, supports board lift during starts and gives you an extra point of contact while riding, turning or pumping.

It works well for wing foil, windsurf foil, surf foil and other boards where quick connection with the board and easy foot release are important.

Ergonomic shape and soft padding

The Cobra Half Hook OS has an ergonomic foot-holding shape that supports the foot from above without creating the locked-in feel of a full strap. Upturned edges improve comfort and help reduce pressure points during the session.

Inside, the hook uses 10 mm foam padding and 4 mm neoprene, giving the contact area a softer feel even during longer time on the water.

Strong HDPE construction

The main hook body is made from injection-moulded HDPE — High Density Polyethylene. This material is strong, resistant to deformation and well suited to parts mounted directly on boards used in water sports.

An oversized stainless steel washer helps spread the mounting load more evenly and improves the stability of the connection.

One size fits most

Dakine Cobra Half Hook OS comes in a universal size designed to fit most riders. It is a practical choice if you want extra foot support and control without switching to full footstraps.

name: Double-Density EVA 3M Self Adhesive Nose Protector Unifiber
short_description: Unifiber stick-on nose protector is a cushioning EVA foam protector with 3M adhesive, designed for windsurf boards. It helps protect the board nose from mast impacts during catapults, wipeouts and waterstarts.
description:
Simple protection against expensive damage

Catapults happen to everyone - especially while learning, sailing in stronger conditions or getting used to new gear. That is exactly when the board nose is most exposed to mast hits. This protector helps reduce the risk of cracks, dents and laminate damage before it turns into a costly repair.

It is a useful accessory for riders who are still building confidence on the water, but also for anyone who simply wants extra protection for everyday use.

Double-density EVA foam

The protector is made from double-density EVA foam. The firmer outer layers help disperse the force of impact, while the softer inner core absorbs shock. This makes it more effective than a basic single-layer protector.

This construction works well against typical mast hits on the nose of the board and helps limit the consequences of mistakes that are simply part of progressing in windsurfing.

Quick installation with 3M adhesive

Thanks to the self-adhesive 3M backing, installation is quick and easy. Just peel off the protective layer and stick the protector onto the board nose. No extra glue, no tools and no mess.

It is a convenient solution if you want to protect your board right after purchase or quickly get your setup ready for the season.

Universal shape for different boards

The protector has a universal shape and a flexible construction, so it can be fitted to many different types of boards. The lowered corners help avoid contact with the sail, which is especially useful during waterstarts and transitions.

It fits a wide range of board shapes and sizes - from freeride boards to more performance-oriented models.

Light and practical

The protector is lightweight, so it does not noticeably affect the way the board feels on the water. It is a simple add-on that can save a lot of stress and repair costs - especially the first time it takes a proper hit.

It is also worth knowing that after very long-term use, the 3M adhesive may leave a light residue after removal. If needed, it can be cleaned off with a suitable solvent.

name: Universal Nose Protector JP-Australia
short_description: JP-Australia Universal Nose Protector is a lightweight board nose protector made from layered EVA and hard PVC. It helps protect the nose from impacts, scratches and everyday damage during learning, transport and regular use. The 3-piece construction allows the protector to fit different board nose shapes and sizes.
description:
Universal board nose protection

JP-Australia Universal Nose Protector is a practical nose guard designed to reduce the risk of damage in one of the most exposed areas of the board. It is especially useful for windsurfing beginners, schools, rental centres and riders who often transport their gear or place the board on hard surfaces.

The protector is made from lightweight layered EVA with a hard PVC outer layer. This combination adds protection without unnecessary weight and helps absorb impacts, dents and scratches that can happen during daily use.

3-piece construction for different boards

The set consists of three parts: one left side piece, one right side piece and one middle section. This layout makes it easier to adapt the protector to different nose widths, outlines and board shapes.

The middle part is positioned in the centre of the board nose, while the side pieces can be rotated and adjusted parallel to the board outline. This makes the Universal Nose Protector suitable for many JP-Australia boards and other boards with a similar nose shape.

Layered impact-absorbing construction

The hard 2 mm PVC top layer helps prevent scratches and spreads impact force over a larger area. Underneath, different EVA layers with varied density and hardness work together to absorb impact energy.

The 5 mm hard EVA layer provides stable support, the 4 mm soft EVA layer helps absorb shocks, and the 10 mm medium-density EVA layer helps distribute pressure. In practice, the protector reduces the risk of local nose damage caused by mast, boom or ground contact.

Simple glue-on installation

The protector is glued directly to the board nose. Before mounting, position the pieces, mark the correct placement with a pencil, clean the surface and make sure both the board and protector are dry, dust-free and free from oil or grease.

You can use a suitable contact adhesive, two-component epoxy glue, super glue or another waterproof and UV-stable power adhesive. After applying the glue, press the protector firmly into place and secure it with tape until the adhesive is fully dry.

Who is the JP-Australia Universal Nose Protector for?

JP-Australia Universal Nose Protector is a good choice for riders who want to protect the board nose from common damage. It will be especially useful for beginner windsurfers, schools, rental centres and anyone who often transports gear or sails in conditions where the board may come into contact with the mast, boom, dock, shore or ground.

It is a small accessory that can help reduce repair costs and extend the lifespan of the board without noticeably affecting handling.

name: NeilPryde Boom Protector
short_description: The NeilPryde Boom Protector is a protective pad for the windsurfing boom head, designed to reduce the chance of board damage and minimize the risk of injury from accidental contact. With secure and easy attachment, it lets you focus entirely on your session.
description:
Protection for a sensitive area

The boom head is one of the parts of the rig that can easily hit the board and leave marks or cause damage. The NeilPryde Boom Protector is designed to cover this hard contact point and reduce the risk of impact. This is especially useful during everyday riding, learning sessions, manoeuvres, and situations where the rig comes close to the deck more often.

It is a smart addition if you want to keep your board in better condition for longer and avoid accidental dents.

Extra safety on the water

This protector does not just help protect the board - it also reduces the risk of painful contact with the hard boom head itself. In practice, it is a small accessory that can improve comfort and safety during sessions, especially in falls, waterstarts, or when handling the sail in more demanding conditions.

It does not change the feel of the setup, but it can make everyday use more forgiving.

Secure fit

NeilPryde describes this model as a secure-fitting protector pad, meaning it is designed to stay in place around the boom head. That matters, because a protector like this should work exactly where it is needed without shifting around during use.

Simple and practical solution

The NeilPryde Boom Protector is one of those accessories that is not complicated, but simply makes sense. You fit it once and gain an extra layer of protection in one of the most exposed areas of the rig. It is a good choice both for everyday sailing and for gear that gets used heavily.

name: DAKINE Harness lines Fixed - Deep Lake
short_description: Dakine Fixed Lines are fixed windsurfing harness lines with a stitched-not-tied construction for a clean and simple boom setup. Pre-stretched FSE Robline® rope, high-density polyurethane tubing and non-slip boom pads help keep the lines stable while sailing.
description:
Fixed harness lines for windsurfing

Dakine Fixed Lines are classic fixed harness lines for windsurfing. They are a simple choice for riders who already know their preferred harness line length and do not need on-the-fly adjustment while sailing.

The stitched-not-tied construction means the lines are sewn rather than knotted. This gives them a clean finish on the boom and removes unnecessary bulk that could get in the way when handling the sail.

Durable rope and stable boom fit

The lines use 8-fold pre-stretched FSE Robline® rope, which helps limit unwanted stretching during use. High-density polyurethane tubing protects the rope and improves durability during regular windsurfing sessions.

Non-slip boom pads help keep the lines in the chosen position on the boom. This is useful when you want a stable sail balance point and a repeatable harness stance.

Dakine Lines OS are simple and reliable windsurfing harness lines. They are made for riders who want to set their preferred line length, mount the lines on the boom and ride without constant adjustment during the session.

Unlike ready-made fixed lines in one set length, this model allows custom adjustment. The line is knotted at each end, so you can trim the polyurethane tubing to the length you need and fine-tune the setup with the knots. This makes it easier to find the position that matches your stance, boom height and riding style.

Durable rope and stable boom grip

The lines use 8-plait pre-stretched FSE Robline® rope, designed to handle regular load on the water. High-density polyurethane tubing protects the rope from wear where it contacts the harness hook.

Non-slip boom pads help keep the lines in the selected position and reduce unwanted movement while sailing. Easy part replacement is another practical benefit, especially if you want a simple setup that can be serviced without replacing the whole system.

Who is it for?

Dakine Lines OS are a good choice for windsurfers who want fixed harness lines but have not yet settled on their preferred length. They work well for freeride, learning to use a harness, everyday sessions and setups where simplicity and easy maintenance matter.

Dakine Fixed Line 20" - fixed harness lines for windsurfing

Dakine Fixed Line 20" OS are classic fixed harness lines for windsurfing. They are designed for riders who want to set their preferred line length, mount them on the boom and ride without adjusting the setup during the session.

Unlike tied harness lines, Dakine Fixed Lines use a stitched construction for a cleaner and more stable setup on the boom. They are a good choice for windsurfers who value simplicity, reliability and a consistent harness position.

Durable rope and wear protection

The lines use 8-plait pre-stretched FSE Robline® rope, which helps maintain stable length and handle regular load on the water. High-density polyurethane tubing protects the rope from wear in the area that contacts the harness hook.

The U-shaped opening makes hooking in and out easier, while non-slip boom pads help keep the lines in the selected position. This reduces unwanted movement during reaches, manoeuvres and powered sailing.

Who is it for?

Dakine Fixed Line 20" is a practical option for windsurfers who do not need adjustable harness lines and prefer a fixed, predictable setup. The shorter 20" length can suit riders sailing closer to the rig, using smaller sail setups or preferring a more compact body position.

name: Windsurf rig XO Sails Swing Dacron Complete rig ALU
short_description: XO-SAILS Swing Dacron Complete Rig ALU is a complete windsurf rig designed for learning , schools , centres and beginners . The Dacron sail with its deep, forgiving profile makes sail feedback easier to understand, while the aluminium mast and the rest of the hardware pack create a practical, ready-to-rig setup. It is a durable and straightforward package for first sessions in light to moderate wind.
description:
A simple rig for learning and school use

XO-SAILS Swing Dacron Complete Rig ALU combines the Swing V2 sail with the ALU hardware pack, creating a complete windsurf rig for learning and training use. It is designed to keep handling simple, improve durability and make day-to-day gear organisation easier.

A sail that does not overwhelm beginners

Swing V2 uses a deep, forgiving profile that gives beginners clear feedback on the water. This makes it easier to understand balance, wind direction and basic sail control. The diagonally cut foot improves the rig’s freedom of movement over the board, which helps with steering and manoeuvring, especially on larger beginner boards.

Durable construction for intensive use

The sail is built from Dacron and fitted with a PVC window. This construction works well for frequent use in schools and rental environments. Reinforced areas in sections exposed to contact with the board and the ground help reduce everyday wear.

ALU hardware pack - a practical and consistent system

The pack includes an aluminium mast, boom, base and uphaul, all packed in a convenient bag. The XO Sails x Unifiber system keeps logistics simple, because all sails of the same size fit the same mast and boom. This makes storage, transport and replacement of individual parts much easier.

A good solution for schools and centres

This rig works especially well where fast setup, consistent equipment and easy handling matter. Colour-coded sizes are an added practical detail, making it easier to organise lessons and identify rigs on the water.

name: Windsurf rig XO Sails Vega Complete rig
short_description: XO-SAILS Vega X-Ply Complete Rig is a complete windsurf rig for wave , Bump & Jump and freeride use, built for riders who want better control, durable construction and more refined hardware. The sail with X-Ply panels is designed for regular use, while the 50% carbon mast improves response and supports earlier planing.
description:
A versatile rig for different conditions

XO-SAILS Vega X-Ply Complete Rig combines the Vega sail with selected Unifiber Essentials components, creating a more refined setup for riders who want one rig that works across a broad range of conditions. Vega performs well in wave sailing, lively Bump & Jump sessions and freeride on flat water, while its feel changes depending on size. Smaller sizes are more manoeuvrable, medium sizes offer a balanced mix of control and stability, and larger sizes hold their shape and power better in stronger wind.

An X-Ply sail for regular use

Vega uses a construction based on white bi-ply, 4 mil X-ply and a full X-ply window. This material mix provides good UV resistance and improved durability for regular sailing. Tapered battens help maintain a clean sail profile, while the broad trim range makes it easier to tune the sail to the conditions and your riding style. It is a good option for riders who want performance with a more durable build than a simpler monofilm sail.

50% carbon mast - better response and sail feel

This rig uses the Unifiber Essentials RDM C50 Constant Curve mast, built with 50% carbon content. Compared to simpler constructions, it delivers a more responsive and lively feel, improves sail reaction and helps with earlier planing. Its Constant Curve bend matches the Vega well and helps unlock more of the sail’s potential across a wider wind range.

Who this rig is for

This is a rig for riders who want to step up from basic school-oriented setups. It suits windsurfers looking for a more versatile package for regular sailing, with a more durable sail and a better mast. Vega X-Ply Complete Rig is a sensible choice for freeride, Bump & Jump or wave riders who want a more refined overall feel.

Unifiber Essentials boom - one complete section

The boom is built around Unifiber Essentials components: the Modular RDM and SDM Compatible Boom Head, Aluminium Essentials Monocoque Tapered Body and Aluminium Essentials Inside Tail. Together, these parts create one consistent aluminium boom with a practical and solid construction. Compatibility with both RDM and SDM masts adds versatility, while the tapered body helps balance stiffness, grip comfort and everyday durability.

Extension and uphaul included

The set is completed with the Unifiber RDM/SDM Essentials V2 Aluminium Mast Extension (U-Pin) and Unifiber Essentials Uphaul String. The aluminium RDM/SDM extension allows proper rig setup, while the uphaul makes day-to-day handling and pulling the sail out of the water easier.

name: NeilPryde X-Base Plate -windsurf baseplate lower unit, without joint and pin
short_description: NeilPryde X-Base Plate is the lower part of a windsurfing baseplate, designed for mounting directly in the board’s mast track. The dual T-nut connection gives a secure, slip-resistant fit, while the low-profile shape makes it easier to pack the board into a boardbag without removing the whole base system after every session.
description:
Lower baseplate part for windsurfing boards

NeilPryde X-Base Plate is the base unit mounted directly in the mast track of a windsurfing board. It works as the lower part of the NeilPryde X-Base system and creates a stable connection point for the removable upper baseplate unit. It is a practical spare part or an additional base for a second board if you use a compatible NeilPryde X-Base setup.

Secure mast track connection

The plate uses a dual T-nut connection, which improves stability and helps prevent the base from slipping while sailing. Compared with a single-point mounting system, this gives a more secure connection, especially under higher rig loads or when you often adjust the base position.

Low profile for easier transport

The low-profile design reduces the number of protruding parts left on the deck. After removing the upper unit, you can leave the base plate in the mast track, making it easier to pack the board into a boardbag and reducing the risk of catching the cover or other gear.

Practical for frequent sessions

X-Base Plate is useful if you sail often and do not want to remove the entire baseplate after every session. You can leave the plate on the board and take the removable upper unit separately for cleaning, transport or storage. This saves time during setup and reduces wear on mounting parts.

When do you need a separate X-Base Plate

The X-Base Plate is a useful addition if you ride more than one board. Instead of buying a complete baseplate for each board, you can mount a plate in every board’s mast track, set each one precisely to your preferred position — and then simply move the upper joint unit between boards. That way every board in your quiver is always ready at your personal sweet spot, with no re-adjusting needed before each session.

page_title: Windsurf baseplate NeilPryde X-Base UXT - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Windsurf baseplate NeilPryde X-Base UXT
short_description: NeilPryde X-BASE UXT is a low-profile windsurfing baseplate with the UXT Pin system, designed for a secure and practical connection between your rig and board. The dual T-nut connection helps prevent slipping in the mast track, while the removable tendon & pin unit makes transport, cleaning and storage easier.
description:
Low-profile UXT windsurfing baseplate

NeilPryde X-BASE UXT is a windsurfing baseplate designed to make rig setup, transport and maintenance easier. Thanks to the removable tendon & pin unit, you do not need to remove the entire baseplate from the board after every session. This is useful if you sail often, carry your board in a boardbag or want to prepare your setup faster before the next session.

Dual T-nut connection

The baseplate uses two T-nut screws for a secure and stable connection with the mast track. This reduces the risk of the baseplate slipping while sailing and allows precise position adjustment on the board. You'll appreciate this especially when you stick to a single setting for a given board

Removable tendon & pin unit

The tendon & pin unit detaches in seconds. This makes transport, cleaning and storage easier without removing the base from the board. It is also practical when packing the board into a boardbag - fewer protruding parts mean less risk of catching or damaging other gear.

Ultra-low profile for a closer rig-to-board connection

The ultra-low profile reduces the gap between the sail and the board, supporting the Close the Gap setup. In practice, it helps keep the rig lower and closer to the deck, which can improve control and give the setup a more direct feel. The lower design also saves space during transport.

Built-in T30 tool

The UXT version includes an integrated T30 tool. This lets you make basic adjustments or remove the unit without searching for a separate key in your gear bag. It is a small detail, but one that can make setup on the spot much easier.

Tougher tendon and safe finish

The tendon joint uses a high-tech material that, according to NeilPryde, is around 50% tougher and more durable than conventional black compounds. The tendon is also easy to replace when needed. The safety rope is made from ultra-strong UHMWPE, while the rounded edges help reduce the risk of damaging the board, sail or boardbag during handling and transport.

What this means on the water

The X-Base UXT sits roughly 3-4 cm lower than NeilPryde’s previous extension. In practice this means the sail sits closer to the board, lowering the centre of force of the rig. The result is easier handling and better control — something both racers and freestylers will notice.

One practical tip: because the sail sits lower with this baseplate, you can raise the boom slightly compared to your previous setup. This actually helps the sail work better and gives you a bit more room to work with.

For position on the mast track: moving the baseplate forward gives more control, moving it backward gives a more direct feel. The dual T-nut connection means you can lock it precisely and it will stay exactly where you set it.

The UXT version includes a built-in T30 Torx key in the head of the extension. This is the same key used for all screws on new JP-Australia boards — footstrap inserts, air valve and fin. If you ride a JP board, one baseplate covers all your beach adjustments without carrying a separate tool.

name: Mast extension Duotone Power.XT SDM
short_description: The Duotone Power.XT 2.0 SDM extension rod is made of high-quality T8 aluminium alloy, giving it an optimum strength-to-weight ratio. The integrated lever makes rigging faster and more efficient.
description:
An inspiring (r)evolution - POWER.XT 2.0 can do much more and does it better than the previous model.

Apart from the basic idea, the POWER.XT 2.0 has almost nothing in common with the previous model anymore. From the extremely robust lever ratchet mechanism to the simplified release mechanism, the extra-strong Lyros® Dyneema lines and the option to attach an additional shock absorber, everything has been radically upgraded. The latest version features a completely new length adjustment ring, based on the tried and tested SDM adjustment ring. Now, for the first time, the RDM version ensures that the aluminum tube does not come into contact with the mast, thus avoiding corrosion on contact. To guarantee the same durability despite the reduced diameter, a double-wall construction of 7075 aluminum outer tube and oval T8 inner tube is used.

For many years, POWER.XT has been the benchmark when it comes to extensions that make trim easier. Those who use it will never want to do without it again. Thanks to the integrated lever, even a child can manage to dial a large slalom sail. It is also possible to adjust the tension after the mast on the water! The 15-centimetre lever allows trim without any effort.

Rapid Release - FAST DEMONSTRATION! Thanks to the modified cleat position, you can easily unhook the line by placing your foot on the extension and briefly yanking the line upwards. Click and you're done!

Shox Upgrade Kit - PIONEERING SHOCK-ABSORBING TECHNOLOGY! All UNI.XT and POWER.XT 2.0 extensions can be upgraded using the unique Duotone SHOX system (except AERO). SHOX is the first integrated shock absorber that uses shock absorbers similar to those on a mountain bike. Especially on choppy water, it is able to noticeably improve the handling of the board and sail. It also dampens landing impacts brilliantly. Tests in all leading Windsurfing magazines have proven that the set-up jumps less on the chops. The rider can convert wind force into acceleration much more efficiently, making you 2-3 knots faster. Shox also protects your equipment and joints. Whether speed, slalom or freeride, the SHOX.UPGRADE.KIT guarantees more control, more speed and more comfort. When wave sailing, the SHOX cushioning system provides softer landings and more control of the board when riding a wave as well as when crossing the surf. No wonder almost all team riders rely on the SHOX option instead of opting out!

name: Mast extension NeilPryde MXT RDM Alloy 34
short_description: RDM aluminium extension with NeilPryde's exclusive MXT connection system. Super easy handling, quick rig detachment and incredible durability make it a great choice for racers but also for recreational windsurfing. MXT extensions are only compatible with the MXT Power Base.
description:
Used by most sailors on the PWA TOUR, the Mono-Button Mast Base and Extension System (MXT) has been designed to offer a secure, heavy-duty connection and ease of operation.

The MXT Extensions are fully integrated with stainless steel cleat/pulley bottom assemblies, offering the best weight to stiffness ratio and creating very light but also very strong extensions. The weight has been reduced by eliminating all unnecessary plastic while increasing the cross-section of stainless steel parts for increased strength. This part can now withstand over 900kg of downhaul load – twice as much as used on the largest racing sails.

The special geometry with tilt bottom pulley makes perfect sail pulley/rope alignment. This allows the sail to be downhauled all the way down (block-to-block) and it reduces downhauling friction.
features: MXT Large Mono-button - For a secure, heavy duty connection and ease of operation. Only compatible with Power Base MXT.

Strong integrated pulleys - Load carrying stainless caste structure - transfers load directly from the pulleys onto the extension tube without relying on any plastic components. Stainless pulleys for less friction and greater durability.
Spectra rope - Endurance tested highest grade rope for best performance, reduced friction and longevity.
Rope cleat - The rope cleat is integrated into the stainless caste structure and is perfectly aligned with pulleys for streamlined profile, maximum strength and reduced friction of lines.

Clamshell adjustment system - • Easy, user friendly operation in all temperatures. 
• Heavy duty stainless steel construction - designed to sustain high loads. 
• Positive engagement - completely unaffected by sand. 
• Increased tube strength due to the absence of any grooves.
Tack slot - Clever hook to keep the tack webbing in place

page_title: Windsurf mast Loftsails Vision IV C75 RDM - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Windsurf mast Loftsails Vision IV C75 RDM
short_description: Loftsails Vision IV C75 RDM is a reduced-diameter windsurfing mast designed for freeride, wave and performance-oriented sailing. Its 75% T700 and T800 carbon construction provides fast reflex, while the durable pre-preg laminate offers the strength required for regular and demanding use.
description:
Versatile high-carbon RDM mast

Loftsails Vision IV C75 RDM is designed for windsurfers who want a noticeable improvement in sail response without moving to a full-carbon competition mast. Its 75% carbon content provides quick recovery after flexing and helps reduce rig weight while maintaining the durability required for frequent sailing.

The mast is suitable for recreational freeride, competitive sessions with other riders and regular wave sailing. It offers a practical balance of response, durability and price for intermediate and advanced windsurfers.

T700 and T800 carbon fibres

The mast is made using a combination of T700 and T800 carbon fibres. This material blend provides the required balance of elasticity, low weight and resistance to the loads generated during sailing.

The high carbon content improves mast reflex, allowing the sail to recover its intended profile more quickly after a gust, landing or impact with chop. This results in a more direct rig response, stable power delivery and easier acceleration.

Durable pre-preg construction

Loftsails Vision IV C75 RDM is manufactured using pre-preg materials. The fibres are pre-impregnated with a controlled amount of resin, which produces a consistent laminate and reduces variation between individual masts.

The construction is designed to withstand the demands of wave sailing and intensive use. It also provides suitable resistance to localised loads and friction generated by the sail during operation.

Constant Curve bend profile

The mast features a Constant Curve bend, with 64% base flex and 76% top flex. This bend profile is matched to Loftsails sails and allows the sail to maintain its intended draft depth and leech behaviour.

A correctly matched mast also helps provide the full tuning range of the sail. The profile remains stable, while the upper section can respond effectively to changes in wind strength.

Controlled mast specifications

Precise manufacturing methods reduce differences in bend characteristics between individual masts. Every mast is checked and controlled to ensure that it meets the intended flex and stiffness specifications.

This is particularly important in performance sails, where even small variations in mast behaviour may affect draft position, stability and usable wind range.

RDM diameter

The reduced diameter makes the mast easier to grip during manoeuvres and waterstarts. The RDM construction also offers a favourable wall thickness-to-diameter ratio, improving resistance to localised impacts.

An RDM mast provides a slightly softer and more controlled rig feel than a comparable SDM model. This is particularly useful in wave sailing, choppy water and variable wind.

Who is it for?

Loftsails Vision IV C75 RDM is designed for intermediate and advanced windsurfers sailing freeride, bump & jump and wave. It is a suitable choice for riders who want faster reflex and lower rig weight than a C50 mast, while retaining more durability and a lower price than a C100 model.

Before purchasing, check the mast length, diameter, IMCS stiffness and bend curve recommended by the sail manufacturer.
features: Loftsails mast manufacturing standards - Loftsails masts are manufactured using only the highest-grade materials and pre-preg (fiber cloth that’s pre-impregnated with resin) construction methods that are highly consistent for quality control and superior to traditional ‘wet’ layup processes that do no guarantee even resin transfer, strength and performance. Loftsails use superior T800 & T700 carbon fiber in their masts. T800 is the optimum fiber when under strain and elongation and compression and also delivers superior response action that enhances sails so well. T700 has even more superior resin absorption and consistency and in fact Loftsails leading Team Edition masts use both fabrics for the ultimate blend of quality and performance.
Accurate materials specifaction - The CAD plotter accurately cuts all composite raw materials used in the process. This is vital for consistency of weight control and performance.
Taking shape mandrels - The right mandrel for each model is then chosen so that the required taper, thickness, bend curve and many other characteristics specified for each model can be produced.

Layup and dressing - For confidentiality reasons we cannot show Loftsails’ precise, classified techniques used in the next stages. These steps involve rolling the plotted composite materials onto the mandrel with a closely guarded process on how the unique inner and compression layups are formed and secretive method for how the ferrules are integrated. The stickers are applied at this stage though!
Taping - External finishing such as protective basalt layers and durable finishing tape are applied to protect from camber wear, heat and impact.
Curing - The mast is cooked in an autoclave. It’s vital to closely monitor and precisely control the curation process at various stages for the most consistent results.
QC - Quality Control checks are made such as bend curve measurement, strength under load and impact. Final finishing inspections are then completed before packaging. Next stop – the beach!

short_description: NeilPryde Dragonfly RDM 280 / 340 is a youth-specific RDM windsurf mast designed for children and lightweight riders using NeilPryde Dragonfly sails. It combines low weight with solid durability, and its size-specific stiffness makes it easier for young windsurfers to learn and progress with equipment matched to their body weight and sail size.
description:
A mast designed for kids and young riders

NeilPryde Dragonfly RDM is built specifically for younger riders who need equipment better suited to their weight, strength and smaller sail sizes. Compared with standard adult masts, this model has a flex characteristic that helps young windsurfers feel the sail more naturally and get better performance from it right from the early stages of learning.

The mast was developed to work perfectly with NeilPryde Dragonfly sails, creating a well-matched setup in terms of bend curve and on-water feel. This matters especially during the learning phase, where the right mast has a real impact on how easy the sail is to handle.

Lightweight and durable composite construction

The construction combines fiberglass and carbon fibers. This gives the mast a well-balanced mix of durability and low weight. It stays light enough for young riders to handle comfortably, while still being strong enough for regular use, sail handling practice and the kind of mistakes that naturally come with progression.

The RDM diameter works especially well in youth windsurf equipment. A reduced diameter mast is easier to handle and better suited to smaller hands and lighter rigs.

Two lengths matched to different stages of progression

The 280 version comes with a very soft IMCS 7 stiffness. It is intended for the youngest and lightest windsurfers, who need a more flexible mast so the sail can work properly even under lower load. This helps young riders feel the signature NeilPryde mast flex more easily.

The 340 version has an IMCS 15 stiffness and is the better choice for heavier youths and riders moving into their teenage years. It offers a more supportive feel for bigger sails and is a natural next step for young windsurfers progressing beyond the beginner stage.

Shark Skin - reduced friction in the sail sleeve

The mast features a Shark Skin surface finish, also used in selected NeilPryde mast ranges. This unique low-friction texture helps prevent wet materials from sticking to the mast surface. In practice, it reduces friction and improves how the sail sleeve moves on the mast.

page_title: Windsurf mast Loftsails Vision IV C75 SDM - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Windsurf mast Loftsails Vision IV C75 SDM
short_description: Loftsails Vision IV C75 SDM is a standard-diameter windsurfing mast designed for freeride, freerace and performance-oriented sailing. Its 75% T700 and T800 carbon construction provides quick rig response, while the durable pre-preg laminate withstands the loads and friction generated by cambered sails.
description:
SDM mast for freeride and performance sailing

Loftsails Vision IV C75 SDM combines the fast response of a high-carbon mast with the durability required for regular use. It is designed for recreational freeriders, performance-oriented windsurfers and riders using cambered sails.

The 75% carbon content reduces rig weight and provides faster reflex than a C50 mast. At the same time, the construction remains more durable and affordable than a full-carbon C100 competition model.

T700 and T800 carbon construction

The mast is made using a combination of T700 and T800 carbon fibres. These materials provide high elasticity, efficient recovery after flexing and resistance to the loads generated during acceleration and high-wind sailing.

Fast reflex helps the sail stabilise its profile after gusts and sudden load changes. The rig responds more quickly, making it easier to maintain drive, speed and control in choppy conditions.

Durable pre-preg laminate

Loftsails uses pre-preg technology, in which the fibres are pre-impregnated with a precisely controlled amount of resin. This results in a consistent laminate and reduces unnecessary excess material that would increase weight.

The construction is designed to withstand the loads generated by cambered sails. Its surface and laminate provide suitable resistance to friction caused by camber rotation and regular sail movement.

Standard SDM diameter

The SDM diameter provides high structural stiffness and stable support for the profiles of larger sails. It is particularly suitable for freerace, raceboard and other performance-oriented sails where a deep and stable draft is important.

The standard diameter also supports smooth operation of compatible cambers. This helps maintain predictable profile rotation during manoeuvres and stable sail behaviour at higher speeds.

Constant Curve bend profile

Loftsails Vision IV C75 SDM features a Constant Curve bend profile. Base flex is rated at 64%, while top flex is 76%, matching the bend characteristics required by compatible Loftsails sails.

A correctly matched mast allows the sail to achieve the intended draft depth and leech release. It also helps maintain a broad tuning range at both the downhaul and outhaul.

Consistent production quality

Loftsails uses precise manufacturing methods to reduce variation between individual masts. Every mast is checked for the specifications that affect its behaviour.

Consistent bend characteristics are useful not only for racers. They also make it easier for recreational riders to tune their sails according to the manufacturer’s recommendations and use the full intended wind range.

Balance between performance and durability

Vision IV C75 SDM is lighter and more responsive than entry-level masts with a lower carbon content. However, it is less sensitive and more affordable than a top-specification C100 model.

This makes it a practical choice for riders who want a responsive rig for regular sailing, training and frequent transport.

Who is it for?

Loftsails Vision IV C75 SDM is designed for intermediate and advanced windsurfers sailing freeride, freerace or using larger cambered sails. It is well suited to riders who prioritise a stable profile, quick response and reliable durability.

Before purchasing, check the mast length, diameter, IMCS stiffness and bend curve specified for your sail.
features: Loftsails mast manufacturing standards - Loftsails masts are manufactured using only the highest-grade materials and pre-preg (fiber cloth that’s pre-impregnated with resin) construction methods that are highly consistent for quality control and superior to traditional ‘wet’ layup processes that do no guarantee even resin transfer, strength and performance. Loftsails use superior T800 & T700 carbon fiber in their masts. T800 is the optimum fiber when under strain and elongation and compression and also delivers superior response action that enhances sails so well. T700 has even more superior resin absorption and consistency and in fact Loftsails leading Team Edition masts use both fabrics for the ultimate blend of quality and performance.
Accurate materials specifaction - The CAD plotter accurately cuts all composite raw materials used in the process. This is vital for consistency of weight control and performance.
Taking shape mandrels - The right mandrel for each model is then chosen so that the required taper, thickness, bend curve and many other characteristics specified for each model can be produced.

The stickers are applied at this stage though!
Taping - External finishing such as protective basalt layers and durable finishing tape are applied to protect from camber wear, heat and impact.
Curing - The mast is cooked in an autoclave. It’s vital to closely monitor and precisely control the curation process at various stages for the most consistent results.
QC - Quality Control checks are made such as bend curve measurement, strength under load and impact. Final finishing inspections are then completed before packaging. Next stop – the beach!

name: Windsurf mast Loftsails Spark IV C50 RDM
short_description: Loftsails Spark IV C50 RDM is a reduced-diameter windsurfing mast designed for freeride sailing and skill progression. Its 50% T700 carbon construction, Constant Curve bend and durable pre-preg laminate provide a balanced combination of response, reliability and accessible pricing.
description:
RDM mast for freeride and progression

Loftsails Spark IV C50 RDM is designed for recreational windsurfers looking for a durable mast with good response and predictable behaviour. It is well suited to general freeride sailing, regular sessions and developing skills on the water.

The 50% carbon construction provides noticeably better reflex and a more responsive rig than basic low-carbon masts, while retaining the durability required for frequent use. This makes the Spark IV C50 a practical choice for progressing riders as well as more experienced windsurfers who prioritise reliability and value for money.

50% T700 carbon construction

The mast is made with 50% T700 carbon fibre. This carbon content offers a useful balance between responsiveness, weight and resistance to everyday sailing loads.

Compared with full-carbon performance masts, the Spark IV has a slightly more forgiving character and a more robust construction. At the same time, it provides enough reflex to support efficient sail handling, acceleration and stable power delivery during freeride sailing.

Pre-preg production technology

Loftsails uses a pre-preg construction process, in which the fibres are pre-impregnated with a controlled amount of resin before the mast is formed.

This method produces a more consistent laminate than traditional wet layup processes. It helps maintain uniform material distribution, predictable flex and good structural durability without unnecessary excess resin.

Constant Curve bend profile

Loftsails Spark IV C50 RDM features a Constant Curve bend profile, with 64% base flex and 76% top flex. This characteristic is designed to work correctly with compatible Loftsails sails and other windsurfing sails requiring a similar bend curve.

The correct mast bend helps the sail maintain its intended draft position, twist and tuning range. Every mast is checked and controlled during production to ensure consistent behaviour between individual units.

Durable and forgiving RDM construction

The reduced RDM diameter makes the mast easier to grip during waterstarts and manoeuvres. Its relatively thick walls also improve resistance to localised impacts and the loads associated with regular recreational use.

The construction provides a controlled and forgiving rig feel, which can make the sail easier to handle in gusty wind and changing conditions. It is particularly useful for riders who value predictable power delivery rather than the sharp response of a full-carbon racing mast.

Good price-to-performance ratio

Spark IV C50 offers many of the construction features used in more advanced Loftsails masts at a more accessible price. The combination of T700 carbon, pre-preg production and individually controlled bend characteristics makes it more than a basic entry-level mast.

It is a sensible option when you want to improve sail response without moving to a lighter and more expensive high-carbon model.

Who is it for?

Loftsails Spark IV C50 RDM is suitable for beginner and intermediate windsurfers progressing towards confident freeride sailing. It can also be used by recreational riders looking for a robust mast for regular sessions, travelling or use in more demanding everyday conditions.

Before purchasing, check the recommended mast length, diameter, IMCS stiffness and bend curve specified for your sail.

description:
Loftsails’ highest-specification RDM mast

Loftsails Team Edition IV C100 RDM is the top RDM model in the brand’s mast range. It is designed for riders who expect low weight, fast response and consistent bend characteristics.

The reduced RDM diameter improves grip, makes the rig easier to control and increases resistance to localised impact. At the same time, the 100% carbon construction delivers the fast reflex required by high-performance sails.

T700 and T800 carbon fibres

The mast is made from a combination of T700 and T800 carbon fibres. These materials are selected to provide a balanced mix of low weight, responsiveness and durability.

T800 fibres contribute to stiffness and fast recovery, while T700 fibres help improve resistance to regular sailing loads and impact. This combination maintains performance without excessively compromising durability.

Pre-preg and autoclave-cured construction

The mast is produced using pre-preg technology. The fibres are pre-impregnated with a controlled amount of resin, creating an even and lightweight laminate without unnecessary excess material.

The mast is then cured in an autoclave. High temperature and pressure consolidate the carbon layers, improving tensile strength and resistance to friction and repeated flexing.

Constant Curve and consistent sail behaviour

The Constant Curve bend profile is matched to the characteristics used in Loftsails sails. Base flex is rated at 64%, while top flex is 76%, helping the mast support the intended sail profile and leech release.

Every mast is checked and controlled for bend consistency. This reduces differences between individual units, which is particularly important in high-performance sails that require an accurate mast match.

Fast reflex in variable wind

The high carbon content allows the mast to recover quickly after bending. The sail responds efficiently to gusts, maintains drive and stabilises its profile faster after sudden changes in load.

This is useful during pumping, acceleration, sailing through chop and handling variable wind. The rig responds with less delay, making it easier to maintain speed and control.

RDM diameter

The RDM construction is narrower than a standard SDM mast. It is easier to hold during manoeuvres and waterstarts, while the thicker wall-to-diameter ratio improves resistance to localised impact.

An RDM mast can also provide a slightly softer and more controlled rig feel. Final compatibility still depends on the sail manufacturer’s recommendations, so the required length, diameter and IMCS rating should always be checked before purchase.

Loftsails Team Edition IV C100 RDM is designed for advanced windsurfers and riders using high-performance sails that require a Constant Curve mast. It is a strong choice where low weight, fast reflex, controlled sail response and accurate mast-to-sail compatibility are the priorities.

description:
High-performance SDM windsurfing mast

Loftsails Team Edition IV C100 SDM is the most advanced SDM mast in the brand’s range. It is designed for sails where fast response, profile stability and efficient recovery after each gust are essential.

The standard SDM diameter provides high structural stiffness and reliable support for the sail profile. It is particularly well suited to slalom, race and freerace rigs, where precise mast behaviour translates into better acceleration, control and stability at speed.

T700 and T800 carbon construction

The mast is made from a combination of T700 and T800 carbon fibres. Using both types of carbon helps achieve low weight, high responsiveness and suitable resistance to the loads generated during sailing.

The mast is manufactured using pre-preg material, meaning that the fibres are pre-impregnated with a precisely controlled amount of resin. Compared with traditional wet layup methods, this process creates a more consistent laminate and reduces excess resin, which would otherwise add unnecessary weight.

Autoclave-cured construction

The mast is cured in an autoclave under controlled pressure and high temperature. This process improves the bonding between the carbon layers, increases tensile strength and helps maintain consistent bend characteristics.

As a result, the mast responds quickly to changing loads, allowing the sail to work more efficiently in gusts, during pumping and while accelerating. This is especially important in sails whose profile depends on accurately controlled mast tension.

Constant Curve bend

Loftsails Team Edition IV C100 SDM features a Constant Curve bend profile. The base flex is rated at 64%, while the top flex is 76%, matching the bend characteristics used in Loftsails sails.

The correct bend curve helps maintain the intended draft depth, leech release and tuning range. Every mast is checked and controlled to minimise differences between individual units and sizes.

Low weight and fast reflex

The 460 cm version weighs approximately 1.95 kg. Its low weight reduces rig inertia, making the sail easier to handle during manoeuvres, waterstarts and dynamic sailing.

The high carbon content also improves reflex, meaning the mast returns to its original shape quickly after bending. This allows the sail to recover its stable profile faster, helping maintain drive and control in variable wind.

Who is it for?

Loftsails Team Edition IV C100 SDM is designed for advanced windsurfers, racers and riders using performance-oriented Loftsails sails. It is a suitable choice when precise sail response, low rig weight and the intended sail design characteristics are the priority.

Before purchasing, check the recommended mast length, diameter and bend curve specified for your sail.

page_title: Unifiber Alloy Ergo Boom - Essentials - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Unifiber Alloy Ergo Boom - Essentials
short_description: Unifiber Essentials Alloy Boom - Ergo Head is an aluminium windsurfing boom with a classic single-hinge boom head. Easy operation, included RDM and SDM adapters and compatibility with the Unifiber modular system make it a practical option for regular sailing.
description:
Classic boom head, quick setup

The Unifiber Essentials Alloy Boom - Ergo Head combines an aluminium boom body with the Ergo Boom Head, using a classic single-hinge lever. The mechanism is simple and intuitive, making it easy to rig on the beach and make quick adjustments between sessions.

This version is a good choice for windsurfers who prefer a familiar boom head system and value straightforward operation over the maximum stiffness offered by the Modular Boom Head.

Ergo Boom Head

The Ergo Boom Head is designed around simplicity, low weight and easy handling. It is around 20% lighter than the previous generation and is one of the lighter boom heads in the Unifiber range.

The single-hinge design makes it quick to attach the boom to the mast and easy to control the clamping pressure.

RDM and SDM compatibility

RDM and SDM adapters are included. They provide the correct fit for both common mast diameters and help distribute pressure over a larger area.

This reduces point loading on the mast and provides a secure connection during regular use.

Unifiber modular system

The Ergo Boom Head is fully compatible with Unifiber Essentials, HD and Elite boom bodies. This makes it possible to use the same boom head with different compatible configurations.

It is a practical solution for riders who want to expand or change their setup over time without replacing the complete boom.

4.0 mm polyester rope

The Essentials version is supplied with 4.0 mm pre-stretched polyester rope. It provides secure fastening and is designed for regular windsurfing use.

Alternative to the Modular Boom Head

The Ergo Head focuses on easy operation, low weight and a familiar rigging system. Riders looking for maximum stiffness and the most direct power transfer between boom and mast may prefer the Modular Boom Head instead.

Assembly required

The boom head is supplied as a kit and requires assembly before first use.

name: Unifiber Alloy Ergo Boom - Essentials Tapered
short_description: Unifiber Alloy Ergo Boom Tapered - Essentials is an aluminium windsurfing boom with a 26 mm tapered grip and classic Ergo boom head. The slimmer grip reduces forearm load, making it especially suitable for lighter riders, freeride sailing and bump & jump sessions.
description:
Slimmer grip for better comfort

The Unifiber Alloy Ergo Boom Tapered - Essentials is designed for riders who prefer a narrower grip and want to reduce hand and forearm fatigue during longer sessions.

The tube tapers to 26 mm in the main grip and harness line area. This allows a more natural hand position and requires less effort to hold, which is particularly useful for lighter riders and windsurfers with smaller hands.

T8 aluminium monocoque construction

The boom body is made from T8 aluminium and uses a monocoque construction. The continuous arm structure helps minimise play and improves load distribution during sailing.

Compared with the non-tapered Essentials Alloy Boom, this model uses standard tube wall thickness and is therefore slightly less stiff and durable under high loads. In return, it provides a slimmer and more comfortable grip.

Ergo Boom Head

The Ergo version uses a classic single-hinge boom head with a lever mechanism. It is straightforward to operate and allows the boom to be attached to the mast quickly.

This setup is aimed at riders who prefer a familiar and easy-to-use boom head system.

RDM and SDM adapters are included, allowing the boom to be used with both common mast diameters.

For freeride and bump & jump

The modern arm outline and slightly wider tail make the boom well suited to freeride and bump & jump sails.

Extra clearance in the rear section helps prevent deeper modern sail profiles from pressing against the boom and allows the sail to maintain its intended shape under load.

Differences between sizes

The 140 and 160 sizes feature the Loop & Go system, which makes outhaul attachment quick and simple.

The 180 size uses a wider tail to accommodate larger sails with deeper profiles. It also includes a pulley block for smoother and more precise outhaul adjustment.

Durable finish

High-density EVA is used around the front grip section to improve abrasion resistance in areas exposed to frequent wear.

This boom is designed for regular use and is a practical choice for riders who value comfort and a slimmer grip more than maximum stiffness.

page_title: Unifiber Alloy Ergo Boom - HD - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Unifiber Alloy Ergo Boom - HD
short_description: Unifiber HD Alloy Boom - Ergo Head is a high-stiffness aluminium windsurfing boom available in HD and HD Tapered versions. Increased tube wall thickness, monocoque construction and the classic Ergo Boom Head make it suitable for freeride, freerace, bump & jump and wave sailing.
description:
Stiffer aluminium construction for harder use

The Unifiber HD Alloy Boom - Ergo Head range is designed for riders who want more stiffness and durability from aluminium than standard constructions can offer. Increased tube wall thickness reduces flex under load, improves sail control and provides a more direct feel during faster sailing, jumping and powered-up sessions.

The boom arm profile is shaped to minimise deflection as much as possible. This allows the HD range to approach the stiffness of more expensive carbon constructions while retaining a T8 aluminium frame.

Ergo Boom Head

All versions in this range are equipped with the Ergo Boom Head and its classic single-hinge lever. The mechanism is quick and straightforward to use, making it a good choice for riders who prefer a familiar and traditional boom head system.

RDM and SDM adapters are included to ensure the correct fit for both common mast diameters and to help distribute clamping pressure more evenly.

If maximum mast connection stiffness is the priority, the Modular Boom Head version remains the alternative option.

HD - classic profile and high stiffness

The standard HD Alloy is the most versatile version in the range. The 140 and 160 sizes use 27 mm grip sections, offering a good balance of comfort and stiffness for freeride, bump & jump and wave sailing.

The larger 180 and 200 sizes use 29 mm grip sections and considerably wider tails. This increases stiffness at longer boom settings and provides additional clearance for larger sails with deeper profiles.

HD Tapered - slimmer grip

The HD Tapered version retains the increased wall thickness of the HD construction while using a narrower tube profile through the main grip area.

It is aimed at riders who want the stiffness and durability of the HD range but prefer a slimmer and more comfortable hold. The reduced grip diameter makes the boom easier to wrap the hand around and can help reduce forearm fatigue during longer sessions.

HD Tapered is particularly suitable where comfort, control and structural stiffness are all important.

Tails designed for modern sail profiles

Wider tail outlines provide extra clearance for deeper modern sail profiles and reduce the risk of the sail being distorted by contact with the boom.

Larger sizes use even wider tails, which also increase stiffness under load and improve compatibility with larger freeride and freerace sails.

Built for regular use

High-density EVA is used around the front grip sections to improve abrasion resistance in areas exposed to frequent wear.

Anodised tails improve corrosion resistance and long-term durability, particularly for riders who regularly sail in salt water.

Because of the increased tube wall thickness, HD models are generally heavier than Essentials Alloy booms. The additional weight, however, comes with greater stiffness and improved resistance to higher loads.

Which version should you choose?

HD

The most versatile option for riders looking for a stiff aluminium boom for freeride, bump & jump and wave sailing

HD Tapered

For riders who prefer a slimmer and more comfortable grip while still wanting the stiffness and durability of the HD construction

page_title: Unifiber Alloy Modular Boom - HD - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Unifiber Alloy Modular Boom - HD
short_description: Unifiber HD Alloy Boom is a monocoque aluminium windsurfing boom for freeride, bump & jump and wave sailing. Increased tube wall thickness improves stiffness and durability, while the Modular Boom Concept allows the boom setup to be matched to different sails and rider preferences.
description:
Stiffer construction for demanding sailing

The Unifiber HD Alloy Boom is designed for windsurfers who want more stiffness and durability than a standard aluminium boom can offer. Increased tube wall thickness reduces flex under load, resulting in more direct power transfer and a more solid feel during fast freeride sailing, jumping, bump & jump sessions and wave riding.

The boom arm curves are shaped to resist deflection under load. This helps the HD Alloy deliver stiffness approaching that of more expensive carbon booms while keeping the advantages of aluminium construction.

Monocoque construction

The boom uses a continuous tube running from one side to the other through the front section. Unlike designs where two separate arms are attached to the boom head, the monocoque layout improves load distribution, rigidity and overall durability.

This construction reduces unwanted movement under higher loads and makes the boom better suited to regular, intensive use.

Modular Boom Concept

The boom is part of the Unifiber Modular Boom Concept. The system separates the boom into three compatible components, allowing riders to combine boom heads, bodies and tails according to their setup.

The versions listed here are supplied with the Modular Boom Head, which provides a stiff and direct connection to the mast. RDM and SDM adapters are included, allowing the head to fit both common mast diameters.

Grip diameter matched to boom size

The 140-190 and 160-210 versions use 27 mm grip sections. This diameter provides a comfortable and secure hold for smaller freeride, wave and bump & jump sails.

The 180-230 and 200-250 versions use 29 mm grip sections. The larger diameter increases stiffness at longer boom settings and helps the boom handle the higher loads generated by larger sails.

Wider tails for modern sail profiles

The boom tails are wider to provide more clearance for deeper modern sail profiles and reduce unwanted contact between the sail and boom.

The 180-230 and 200-250 models feature extra-oversized tails, providing additional stiffness and more room for larger, fuller-profile sails.

name: Unifiber Carbon V2 Ergo Boom - HD
short_description: Unifiber Carbon V2 Ergo - HD is a carbon windsurfing boom made from 70% pre-preg carbon, with an Ergo Boom Head and monocoque construction. Available from 140-200 to 220-270 cm in Inside Wide Tail and Outside Wide Tail versions, it covers wave, freeride, bump & jump, freerace and race sailing.
description:
HD carbon construction for more demanding sailing

The Unifiber Carbon V2 Ergo - HD range is designed for windsurfers who want greater stiffness, durability and more direct sail feedback than aluminium booms can provide, without moving to the lighter Elite construction.

The boom body uses a 70% pre-preg carbon lay-up. The reinforced HD construction handles regular high loads well, reduces boom arm flex and provides a more stable feel in gusts and during powered-up sailing.

Monocoque construction and reinforced tube walls

All versions use a Monocoque Boom Body with a continuous arm structure. This improves load distribution, reduces unwanted movement through the front section and supports overall boom stiffness.

Tube wall thickness varies depending on size:

140-200, 160-220 and 170-220 cm - 2.2 mm

190-240 cm - 2.5 mm

220-270 cm - 2.8 mm

The larger versions are therefore further reinforced to handle the higher loads generated by bigger freerace and race sails.

Ergo Boom Head

This version is equipped with the Ergo Boom Head and its classic single-hinge lever. The mechanism is straightforward and familiar to use, allowing quick attachment to the mast and easy clamping adjustment.

The head provides axial movement, helping it align correctly with the boom position on the mast.

RDM and SDM adapters are included, allowing the boom to fit both common mast diameters.

The Ergo Head is a good choice for riders who prefer a traditional and quick boom attachment system rather than the maximum connection stiffness offered by the Modular Boom Head.

Ergonomic grip matched to boom size

The boom arms use an oval profile that sits naturally in the hand and helps improve comfort during longer sessions.

Grip dimensions vary by size:

140-200 and 160-220 cm - 26 x 27 mm

170-220 cm - 27 x 29 mm

190-240 and 220-270 cm - 29 x 30 mm

The smaller versions offer a slimmer hold, while the larger tube sections support stiffness on longer booms under higher loads.

High-density EVA around the front grip section improves abrasion resistance during regular use.

Inside Wide Tail - compact handling

The 140-200, 160-220 and 170-220 cm versions use an Inside Wide Tail, where the boom tail slides inside the boom body.

The inner tail width is 15.5 cm. This provides suitable clearance for modern sails while maintaining a compact and direct feel.

The IWT versions are particularly well suited to wave, bump & jump and freeride sailing.

Outside Wide Tail - for larger sails

The 190-240 and 220-270 cm versions use an Outside Wide Tail, where the boom tail slides over the outside of the boom body.

This layout provides a favourable stiffness-to-weight ratio and helps reduce rear-end swing weight on larger boom sizes.

The 190-240 cm version has a 17 cm inner tail width, making it suitable for larger freeride and freerace sails.

The 220-270 cm version uses a 29 cm inner tail width, providing significantly more clearance for deep-profile large freerace and race sails.

Pulley system on every size

Every Carbon V2 Ergo - HD version features a pulley system at the clew.

This allows smooth and precise outhaul adjustment. On larger setups, it can also be used with an adjustable outhaul system, depending on the chosen rope and hardware configuration.

Configure Me

The boom is part of the Unifiber Configure Me modular system. The boom head, body and tail are separate compatible components.

This allows worn parts to be replaced individually or the boom setup to be adapted without replacing the complete boom.

Easy configuration
