name: Unifiber Carbon V2 Ergo Boom - Elite
short_description: Unifiber Carbon V2 Ergo - Elite is a full-carbon windsurfing boom with an Ergo Boom Head and monocoque construction. Seven versions from 140-200 to 250-300 cm cover wave, bump & jump, freeride, foil, freerace and race sailing with Inside Wide Tail and Outside Wide Tail configurations.
description:
The lightest and stiffest Unifiber boom range

The Unifiber Carbon V2 Ergo - Elite is designed for demanding riders who prioritise low weight, high stiffness and direct sail feedback.

The boom body is made from 100% high-grade pre-preg carbon. This construction minimises flex under heavy load, provides direct power transfer and helps the sail maintain a stable profile during acceleration, strong gusts and high-speed sailing through chop.

Compared with the Carbon HD range, the Elite models are lighter and focus more strongly on maximum stiffness and precise rig feedback.

100% pre-preg carbon monocoque construction

All versions use a monocoque body with a continuous boom arm structure. This improves load distribution and helps reduce unwanted flex under high loads.

Tube wall thickness varies according to boom size and intended use:

140-200, 160-220 and 170-220 cm - 2 mm

190-240 and 205-255 cm - 2.3 mm

220-270 and 250-300 cm - 2.5 mm

The larger versions are reinforced accordingly to handle the loads generated by bigger freerace and race sails.

Ergo Boom Head

The boom is equipped with the Ergo Boom Head and its classic single-hinge mechanism. It provides quick and intuitive attachment to the mast and will feel familiar to riders who prefer a traditional boom head design.

The head allows axial movement, helping it align correctly with the boom position on the mast.

RDM and SDM adapters are included, allowing the boom to fit both common mast diameters.

Grip matched to each application

Grip size and profile vary between models. This allows the smaller versions to use a slimmer, more comfortable grip while larger booms maintain the stiffness required under higher loads.

140-200 Slim - 25 mm grip

160-220 - 26 x 27 mm

170-220 - 27 x 29 mm

190-240, 205-255, 220-270 and 250-300 - 29 x 30 mm

The 140-200 Slim stands out with its 25 mm grip. The reduced diameter makes the boom easier to hold and can reduce forearm load during demanding wave and bump & jump sessions.

High-density EVA around the front grip section improves abrasion resistance during regular use.

Inside Wide Tail - for smaller and medium-sized setups

The 140-200 Slim, 160-220 and 170-220 cm versions use an Inside Wide Tail, where the boom tail slides inside the boom body.

The inner tail width is 15.5 cm. This provides sufficient clearance for modern sail profiles while maintaining compact and direct handling.

The 140-200 Slim is particularly suited to wave and bump & jump sailing, while its wider tail also provides enough clearance for deeper profiles, including cambered and foil sails.

The 160-220 and 170-220 versions extend the range towards freeride and larger sails.

Outside Wide Tail - low swing weight with larger sails

The 190-240, 205-255, 220-270 and 250-300 cm versions use an Outside Wide Tail, where the boom tail slides over the outside of the boom body.

This construction provides a favourable stiffness-to-weight ratio and helps minimise swing weight at the rear of longer booms.

This is especially useful with larger freerace and race sails, where reduced rear-end inertia contributes to lighter handling through transitions and improved control at speed.

The 190-240 cm version has a 17 cm inner tail width. The 205-255, 220-270 and 250-300 cm versions use an extra-wide 29 cm tail to provide ample clearance for very deep race sail profiles.

Pulley system on every size

Every Unifiber Carbon V2 Ergo - Elite boom features a pulley system at the clew.

This allows smooth and precise outhaul adjustment. On larger race setups, the pulley system can also be used with an adjustable outhaul for on-the-water sail trim.

Configure Me

The Carbon V2 Ergo - Elite is part of the Unifiber Configure Me modular boom system. The boom head, body and tail are separate compatible components that can be replaced or reconfigured when required.

If one component becomes worn or damaged, there is no need to replace the complete boom. The modular concept also makes it easier to adapt the setup as your sail quiver changes.

The inner tail width is 15.5 cm. This provides enough clearance for modern sail profiles while maintaining a compact and direct feel.

The IWT versions are particularly well suited to freeride, bump & jump and wave sailing.

Outside Wide Tail - for larger sails

The 190-240 and 220-270 cm versions use an Outside Wide Tail, where the boom tail slides over the outside of the boom body.

This layout provides a favourable stiffness-to-weight ratio and helps reduce rear-end swing weight on larger boom sizes.

The 190-240 cm version has a 17 cm inner tail width and is well suited to larger freeride and freerace sails.

The 220-270 cm version uses a much wider 29 cm tail, providing the clearance required for deep-profile large freerace and race sails.

Pulley system on every size

Every Carbon V2 Modular - HD version features a pulley system at the clew.

This allows smooth and precise outhaul adjustment. On larger setups, the pulley system can also be used with an adjustable outhaul, depending on the chosen configuration and hardware.

Configure Me

The boom is part of the Unifiber Configure Me modular system. The boom head, body and tail are separate compatible components.

This makes it possible to replace a worn part without buying a complete boom, change to a different boom tail or adapt the setup over time.

What the Skyscape 5.2 is made for

The LoftSails Skyscape 5.2 HD was developed for two applications - freefoil and fin sailing. That dual-purpose character means it is intended to combine efficient power delivery, easy handling and solid control both on foil setups and on classic fin boards.

At 5.2 m2, it sits in a very usable range for riders who want a balance between control and practical power. It is a size that makes sense for regular freeride sailing with a modern, lighter rig feel.

Freefoil and fin versatility

One of the main strengths of this model is its dual discipline focus. The sail is not limited to just one style of sailing, so it can be a very practical option for riders who want one model that works both with a foil and with a traditional fin.

In real use, that makes the setup more versatile. If you want a sail with a modern feel that does not lock you into only one board configuration, the Skyscape 5.2 looks like a very sensible choice.

No-cam setup and easier handling

This model uses a no-cam layout, which generally means simpler rigging, a lighter feel in the hands and more direct sail response. That kind of setup fits well with freeride and foil sails, where ease of use, quick reaction and straightforward day-to-day handling matter a lot.

For many riders, the absence of cambers is also a practical advantage when it comes to transport, rigging and overall convenience.

Mast setup and rigging configuration

This points to a compact, modern sail with a straightforward setup, well suited to riders looking for an efficient rig for regular sailing.

Six battens and overall riding character

The sail uses 6 battens, which generally helps maintain better profile stability and a more settled feel on the water. In a model intended for both freefoil and fin use, that kind of layout fits well with the need to combine control, profile stability and smooth power delivery.

It is a configuration that should support predictable sail behavior without moving into the more complex territory of cambered designs.

page_title: Windsurf sail Duotone Idol LTD 2025 Black/White - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Windsurf sail Duotone Idol LTD 2025 Black/White
short_description: Duotone Idol LTD combines maximum wind range with instant acceleration, total neutrality while ducking without nervousness, maximum pop, ultralight weight, yet without compromising durability. This professional freestyle sail will perform excellently while foiling as well.
description:
It took Duotone almost 2 years to develop the next generation of the IDOL LTD. But in the end, it turns out to be the biggest update since its introduction in 2014! But let's take it in order:

Ultralight, but without sacrificing durability

By reducing the panel layout to its functional core and swapping multi-layer with lighter single-layer high-tech reinforcements, the Duotone was able to reduce the weight by another 200g, making the new IDOL LTD one of the lightest Freestyle Competition sails out there. Yet following Duotone LIGHT DONE RIGHT philosophy, they have achieved this without reducing the film thickness, so there is no loss in durability. In addition, they are using virtually unbreakable Epoxy wave-battens, which can easily withstand even the toughest wipe-outs.

For all other aspects, the Duotone unique BATTEN FREE CENTER concept comes into play. Instead of the usual symmetrical batten distribution, the IDOL LTD features a larger gap between the foot batten and the batten above the boom. As there is a larger area without battens, the sail loads up much smoother, which has a tremendous impact on the performance:

- Increased wind-range with earlier planing and instant acceleration as sail loads up faster. Plus more control as the sail can absorb the chop and has more release

- Much easier to duck, as the sail goes neutral but loads up much smoother after ducking. This is completely new compared to the usual radical on-off that you are used to from other Freestyle Competition sails

- Increased lift for air moves due to super efficient loading of the profile

- Helps the sail to remain loaded up to maintain stability

- Lighter feeling due to better release

product_highlights.title: Convex Dacron Luff-Panel
product_highlights.text: Maximum elasticity without distortion from the battens enables maximum lift for all jumps against the sail

product_highlights.title: Batten Free Center
product_highlights.text: Larger gap between the foot batten and the batten above the boom >> better inflation (= planing power) in the boom area and improved stability in the upper sail area

product_highlights.title: LIGHT DONE RIGHT Construction
product_highlights.text: Weight reduction of a clearly noticeable 200 to 300 g without reducing the thickness of the main panel, thus maintaining the well-known durability and longevity!

product_highlights.title: Hollow Lower Leech
product_highlights.text: Hollow Lower Leech (scooped leech outline) stabilises the profile right above the boom and prevents leech fluttering

product_highlights.title: iROCKET 2.0
product_highlights.text: Factory calibrated individual batten tensions using a torque wrench

product_highlights.title: Fastest Ducking
product_highlights.text: Super high clew and short boom allow the fastest possible ducking to avoid loosing any speed

features: 3D Top Cap - Optimised pull. On regular top caps and pin systems, the webbing is connected in a “one-dimensional” way with the sail body (either side to side or front to back), which transfers the downhaul tension only in certain points. The 3D TOP CAP allows a “three-dimensional” and very widespread transition of the downhaul forces into the sail body. This eliminates top fluttering and ensures a progressive loose leech, extending the wind range. The integrated abrasion ribs eliminate the need for heavy, bulky reinforcements at the end of the luff sleeve

Set & Go Vario Top - No more trial and error when trying to find the best vario top setting. Even when first rigging up, the correct length of the vario top is found straight away. Clear length indicators mark out the perfect setting with reference to the mast length used, eliminating any need for testing or re-adjustments

Polyester Webbing Only - Eliminating stretch and loss of tension. If it’s good enough for safety harnesses, it’s good enough for windsurfers! Duotone is the only manufacturer to use only polyester webbing for the (vario) top and the tack roller. This advantage of this compared to conventional polypropylene is the negligible amount of stretch. As a result, even brand-new sails will retain full luff tension and will not need subsequent trimming

Double D Buckle - Inspired by high-strength climbing harnesses and Formula 1 helmets. The exclusive, two-part metal double-D buckle on the vario top, which replaces traditional solutions. This design guarantees the best trimming characteristics and eliminates all webbing slippage

TT Top - Improved sail control at higher winds. Designer Kai Hopf originally designed the TT TOP for the WARP. The reduced, concave shape improves tension conditions for a more effective, three-dimensional top twist. This means the top twists not only horizontally, but also vertically under strong winds. By completely neutralising gusts of wind, the rig is kept steady in the rider’s hands, and thus works in a much larger range of winds

Double Seam Technology - Double the durability with half as much stretch. DUOTONE manufactures products of unmatched quality, which gives our sails a significantly longer lifetime. A key feature which helps to achieve this is the triple-stitch zig-zag seams. Unlike other products with their single-seam design, these are double-seam. They cover all exposed crash areas, which increases tear resistance and reduces bending-elongation by up to 50%, boosting profile stability and performance

VTS - Visual Trim System - Perfect trim and a huge range of use. You won’t find a quicker or more accurate way of trimming your sail. Even beginners can trim the sail in a matter of seconds to 100% accuracy. All you need to do is pull the luff until the top of the loose leech reaches the “lower wind limit” or “upper wind limit”. The VTS acts as a power boost, ensuring maximum performance and broader range of use

IRocket 2.0 - Super-lightweight and aerodynamic. An inconspicuous detail with a massive impact. iROCKET 2.0 batten tensioners are super-lightweight, aerodynamic and highly stable, consisting of high-quality components such as a self-lubricating, salt-water-resistant brass nut with stainless-steel screw which can withstand all batten tensions. Furthermore, the iROCKET 2.0 is an essential component for a true windsurfing revolution. 100% correct batten tension, correctly adjusted when purchased and forever after

Epoxy Batten - Extremely stable, extremely break-resistant. Depending on the range of use, positioning in the sail and the necessary tension, the batten stress is enormous. In order to prevent breakages, the Duotone only fit into all solid battens extremely durable epoxy laminates which really can withstand anything and can live up to DUOTONE’s promises in terms of longevity
Mini Batten - These prevent unwanted leech flutter. Short and highly effective mini-battens which provide support for the areas between the battens and prevent undesirable flutter

XPly Plus - The Duotone use only 150 or 100 micron thick films for their exclusive XPLY PLUS. In an extensive series of tests, they have developed the ideal combination of necessary film thickness and number of threads. The X.PLY PLUS in particular, at 150 microns in thickness, boasts durability characteristics far in excess of previous laminates at minimal weight

Sleeve Opener - Frictionless insertion of the mast into the luff sleeve. An ingenious solution does away with the tedium of inserting the mast. The DUOTONE logo above the boom cutout gently opens the sleeve so that the mast can be threaded with one hand into the luff friction-free, without having to constantly make adjustments to the luff
Triple Tack Roller 3.0 - Find the perfect trim with minimal effort. The integrated, nickel-plated brass triple roller minimizes the downhaul forces tremendously

Individual Boom Length Indication - The correct boom length without the need for trial and error. Because the boom is attached to the mast at different heights depending on body size, and because this creates a different angle to the mast, the boom length will vary. Specific recommendations for the correct length are printed directly on the luff sleeve at the boom level
Foil Eyelet - On all foil approved sails the additional lower clew eyelet helps you to position the sail further upright which makes the sail much more efficient when flying on the hydrofoil
VTS Tail Outhaul Specs - Each sail carries individually defined visual indications for the correct outhaul extension (requires VTS TAIL boom)

Duratech Foot - Long-term guarantee for the sail foot. When starting off on the water or catching up, the foot of the sail is constantly dragged over the nonslip coating, particularly for wide boards. With the exclusive DURATECH FOOT, the seams are completely protected within a large plastic channel so that the surface cannot chafe against seams and material

Twin Strap - This keeps the sail rolled up and holds the protector to the mast. A brilliantly simple fastening system which keeps the sail compact and closed after being rolled up and, when on the water, holds the mast protector closely to the mast

short_description: Unifiber Maverick is a high-performance sail developed for newcomers to windsurfing. The relatively low weight makes this sail easy to uphaul. Highly recommended, using in combination with the recommended mast to gain maximum performance: early planing and upper-end control. The sail is constructed largely from transparent, clear monofilm to give the riders the best possible visibility and reduce weight.
description:
This is a quite high performance sail for newcomers to windsurfing. 5.0 is build with Bump & Jump conditions in mind (maneuverable windsurfing) while larger sizes: 6.5 / 7.3 are designed towards Freeride performance and blasting. This is easy and light sail (low weight) what makes Maverick easy to uphaul and easy to use. Highly recommended using in combination with the dedicated minimum 40% RDM/SDM mast (please refer to specifications) to subtract maximum performance like early planning and upper end control.

Quality Battens

Unlike with many other sails on this price level, Maverick is equipped with high quality batten lay-out, the same you can find at famous Loftsails sails. These are forward-profile batten systems with Standing Battens at specific locations – that’s for responsive, low-end drive and easy upper end handling.

Small sizes, those more towards Bump & Jump windsurfing, have 4 battens (5 battens in 5.8 size), and larger sizes, those dedicated more to pure Freeride sensation, have 6 battens. The more battens your sail has the more stable it is yet the weight increases. With Maverick construction, that issue seems to be very well-balanced.

Upgraded features in 6.5/7.3 sizes

Both these sizes, designed for performance Freeride level blasting, are constructed with some special features. Not only they have 6 high quality battens for stability but also one of them crossing with boom like in high performance sails. That feature assists with better leach opening. Another important feature is the cut-out for the boom which allows using a shorter boom and make your rig more stiff and lighter.

name: Windsurf sail Duotone Idol LTD 2025 Black/Violet
short_description: Duotone Idol LTD combines maximum wind range with instant acceleration, total neutrality while ducking without nervousness, maximum pop, ultralight weight, yet without compromising durability. This professional freestyle sail will perform excellently while foiling as well.
description:
It took Duotone almost 2 years to develop the next generation of the IDOL LTD. But in the end, it turns out to be the biggest update since its introduction in 2014! But let's take it in order:

Ultralight, but without sacrificing durability

By reducing the panel layout to its functional core and swapping multi-layer with lighter single-layer high-tech reinforcements, the Duotone was able to reduce the weight by another 200g, making the new IDOL LTD one of the lightest Freestyle Competition sails out there. Yet following Duotone LIGHT DONE RIGHT philosophy, they have achieved this without reducing the film thickness, so there is no loss in durability. In addition, they are using virtually unbreakable Epoxy wave-battens, which can easily withstand even the toughest wipe-outs.

For all other aspects, the Duotone unique BATTEN FREE CENTER concept comes into play. Instead of the usual symmetrical batten distribution, the IDOL LTD features a larger gap between the foot batten and the batten above the boom. As there is a larger area without battens, the sail loads up much smoother, which has a tremendous impact on the performance:

- Increased wind-range with earlier planing and instant acceleration as sail loads up faster. Plus more control as the sail can absorb the chop and has more release

- Much easier to duck, as the sail goes neutral but loads up much smoother after ducking. This is completely new compared to the usual radical on-off that you are used to from other Freestyle Competition sails

- Increased lift for air moves due to super efficient loading of the profile

- Helps the sail to remain loaded up to maintain stability

- Lighter feeling due to better release

product_highlights.title: Convex Dacron Luff-Panel
product_highlights.text: Maximum elasticity without distortion from the battens enables maximum lift for all jumps against the sail

product_highlights.title: Batten Free Center

product_highlights.title: LIGHT DONE RIGHT Construction
product_highlights.text: Weight reduction of a clearly noticeable 200 to 300 g without reducing the thickness of the main panel, thus maintaining the well-known durability and longevity!

features: 3D Top Cap - Optimised pull. On regular top caps and pin systems, the webbing is connected in a “one-dimensional” way with the sail body (either side to side or front to back), which transfers the downhaul tension only in certain points. The 3D TOP CAP allows a “three-dimensional” and very widespread transition of the downhaul forces into the sail body. This eliminates top fluttering and ensures a progressive loose leech, extending the wind range. The integrated abrasion ribs eliminate the need for heavy, bulky reinforcements at the end of the luff sleeve

Set & Go Vario Top - No more trial and error when trying to find the best vario top setting. Even when first rigging up, the correct length of the vario top is found straight away. Clear length indicators mark out the perfect setting with reference to the mast length used, eliminating any need for testing or re-adjustments

Polyester Webbing Only - Eliminating stretch and loss of tension. If it’s good enough for safety harnesses, it’s good enough for windsurfers! Duotone is the only manufacturer to use only polyester webbing for the (vario) top and the tack roller. This advantage of this compared to conventional polypropylene is the negligible amount of stretch. As a result, even brand-new sails will retain full luff tension and will not need subsequent trimming

Double D Buckle - Inspired by high-strength climbing harnesses and Formula 1 helmets. The exclusive, two-part metal double-D buckle on the vario top, which replaces traditional solutions. This design guarantees the best trimming characteristics and eliminates all webbing slippage

TT Top - Improved sail control at higher winds. Designer Kai Hopf originally designed the TT TOP for the WARP. The reduced, concave shape improves tension conditions for a more effective, three-dimensional top twist. This means the top twists not only horizontally, but also vertically under strong winds. By completely neutralising gusts of wind, the rig is kept steady in the rider’s hands, and thus works in a much larger range of winds

Double Seam Technology - Double the durability with half as much stretch. DUOTONE manufactures products of unmatched quality, which gives our sails a significantly longer lifetime. A key feature which helps to achieve this is the triple-stitch zig-zag seams. Unlike other products with their single-seam design, these are double-seam. They cover all exposed crash areas, which increases tear resistance and reduces bending-elongation by up to 50%, boosting profile stability and performance

VTS - Visual Trim System - Perfect trim and a huge range of use. You won’t find a quicker or more accurate way of trimming your sail. Even beginners can trim the sail in a matter of seconds to 100% accuracy. All you need to do is pull the luff until the top of the loose leech reaches the “lower wind limit” or “upper wind limit”. The VTS acts as a power boost, ensuring maximum performance and broader range of use

IRocket 2.0 - Super-lightweight and aerodynamic. An inconspicuous detail with a massive impact. iROCKET 2.0 batten tensioners are super-lightweight, aerodynamic and highly stable, consisting of high-quality components such as a self-lubricating, salt-water-resistant brass nut with stainless-steel screw which can withstand all batten tensions. Furthermore, the iROCKET 2.0 is an essential component for a true windsurfing revolution. 100% correct batten tension, correctly adjusted when purchased and forever after

Epoxy Batten - Extremely stable, extremely break-resistant. Depending on the range of use, positioning in the sail and the necessary tension, the batten stress is enormous. In order to prevent breakages, the Duotone only fit into all solid battens extremely durable epoxy laminates which really can withstand anything and can live up to DUOTONE’s promises in terms of longevity
Mini Batten - These prevent unwanted leech flutter. Short and highly effective mini-battens which provide support for the areas between the battens and prevent undesirable flutter

XPly Plus - The Duotone use only 150 or 100 micron thick films for their exclusive XPLY PLUS. In an extensive series of tests, they have developed the ideal combination of necessary film thickness and number of threads. The X.PLY PLUS in particular, at 150 microns in thickness, boasts durability characteristics far in excess of previous laminates at minimal weight

Sleeve Opener - Frictionless insertion of the mast into the luff sleeve. An ingenious solution does away with the tedium of inserting the mast. The DUOTONE logo above the boom cutout gently opens the sleeve so that the mast can be threaded with one hand into the luff friction-free, without having to constantly make adjustments to the luff
Triple Tack Roller 3.0 - Find the perfect trim with minimal effort. The integrated, nickel-plated brass triple roller minimizes the downhaul forces tremendously

Individual Boom Length Indication - The correct boom length without the need for trial and error. Because the boom is attached to the mast at different heights depending on body size, and because this creates a different angle to the mast, the boom length will vary. Specific recommendations for the correct length are printed directly on the luff sleeve at the boom level
Foil Eyelet - On all foil approved sails the additional lower clew eyelet helps you to position the sail further upright which makes the sail much more efficient when flying on the hydrofoil
VTS Tail Outhaul Specs - Each sail carries individually defined visual indications for the correct outhaul extension (requires VTS TAIL boom)

Duratech Foot - Long-term guarantee for the sail foot. When starting off on the water or catching up, the foot of the sail is constantly dragged over the nonslip coating, particularly for wide boards. With the exclusive DURATECH FOOT, the seams are completely protected within a large plastic channel so that the surface cannot chafe against seams and material

Twin Strap - This keeps the sail rolled up and holds the protector to the mast. A brilliantly simple fastening system which keeps the sail compact and closed after being rolled up and, when on the water, holds the mast protector closely to the mast

name: Windsurf board JP-Australia Magic Ride WOOD PRO 2026
short_description: FREERIDE / MANOEUVRE FREERIDE The JP-Australia Magic Ride is a manoeuvre-oriented freeride board that combines very early planing, easy handling and playful carving with a sporty, lively character. It sits high on the water, accelerates quickly and keeps full control even as the pace goes up. For many riders it is the most enjoyable and user-friendly freeride board JP has ever made.
description:
Board character

Since the first generation, the Magic Ride has stood for effortless freeriding and smooth jibes. This latest version is faster, more responsive and noticeably more composed in chop. The board carves naturally, keeps speed through the turn and feels incredibly intuitive underfoot. Whether you are learning planing jibes or pushing into tighter, more dynamic carving, the Magic Ride makes every turn feel easy and predictable.

Construction

The board comes in two constructions, Wood Pro (WP) and ES, each with its own feel. Wood Pro is lighter, stiffer and more responsive, offering the most direct handling and also being foil approved. ES is the more durable everyday option, designed to cope with long-term use while staying comfortable and predictable. Both share a strong combination of paulownia, Innegra and glass reinforcements for long-lasting performance.

Shape and details

Magic Ride is built on a thin, wide platform that helps the board pop into planing with almost no effort. The stretched-out waterline makes early planing easier and improves tracking at higher speeds. The wide nose gives confidence at low speeds, while the wide tail releases water efficiently, reduces drag and improves control when fully powered.

The deck shape provides a comfortable stance in all footstrap configurations and makes getting in and out of the straps straightforward. Underneath, the pronounced V flow and double concave smooth out chop and help the board enter carving turns with very little input. This bottom shape delivers the lively, playful feel that defines the Magic Ride.

On the water

On the water, the Magic Ride feels light, natural and predictable. It reaches planing speed quickly and keeps it easily, even in gusty wind. The fin offers plenty of grip, allowing the board to fly comfortably and stay controlled at higher speeds. Jibing is where the board really shines: it initiates turns effortlessly and maintains speed until the very end of the carve. It is equally rewarding for intermediate riders who want to improve their jibes and advanced sailors aiming for dynamic carving.

Who is it for

This is a board for a wide range of freeriders. Intermediate sailors appreciate its forgiving nature and very early planing, while advanced riders enjoy its speed, responsiveness and energetic character. The Magic Ride 159 is ideal for riders stepping down from large beginner boards with a daggerboard and wanting a smooth transition into planing boards.

Differences in construction: Wood Pro vs ES

Wood Pro - this version is lighter, more responsive and has a noticeably more direct feel. The paulownia bottom sandwich, parabolic rail reinforcements and strong Innegra protection in the bow make the board stiff and lively. It also comes with a Foil-Powerbox, so you can mount a foil without hesitation. This is the choice for riders who want maximum performance, quick feedback and the option to foil.

ES - construction focuses on durability and comfort. Biax-Glass reinforcements, a significantly strengthened bow and a standard Powerbox create a robust build that can handle plenty of everyday use. It is slightly heavier, but very stable and predictable, making it ideal for riders who want a reliable all-round freeride board that performs well in all conditions.

short_description: Duotone BLAST is a freeride/freerace windsurf board designed for intermediate and advanced riders looking for the perfect mix of comfort and speed . It combines easy jibing with excellent control across a wide wind range .
description:
Duotone BLAST takes your freeride and freerace sessions to the next level. If you’re already comfortable sailing in footstraps and want to progress faster, BLAST will guide you from your first power jibes up to pro-level laydown jibes.

Based on the Volume Yet Control concept, the board allows you to choose a bigger size compared to other brands without losing control in stronger winds. This translates into earlier planing and more stability in non-planing conditions, without compromising high-end performance.

Thin rails allow experienced riders to carve aggressive jibes, while the wide tail ensures smooth and forgiving turns for intermediates. Outboard strap positions and boxy rails let you push harder on the fin for maximum speed, and tail cutouts reduce drag at top speed.

The BLAST comes in two constructions: standard Epoxy Sandwich and high-end SLS Premium Sandwich Technology for extra lightweight stiffness and precision.

page_title: Windsurf board Exocet RS V5 Carbon - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Windsurf board Exocet RS V5 Carbon
short_description: Dedicated slalom machine, the RS design undergoes constant development and fine-tuning, ensuring top-notch performance on the race course. For professional and demanding advanced windsurfers to sail at at full speed and maintaining control in the widest range of conditions possible.
description:
To sustain the racer's concentration on upholding speed throughout the course, subtle adjustments have been made to all outlines to enhance control even in rough conditions. Notably, the widest point of the board has been shifted closer to the nose while maintaining the same tail width. This refinement flattens the outline curve, significantly improving control on straight lines and allowing to approach gybes with greater speed.

The bottom shape features a mono concave beneath the nose that transitions into a consistent V shape from underneath the mast track to the back foot. This configuration aids in sustaining speed and direction even when facing challenging choppy conditions.

In the footstraps area, deck thickness has been reduced to re-balance front and back foot positions. With a new setup, the front foot will feel less "loose" in rough conditions. Alongside this, the slight increase in rail thickness in the nose area boosts the early planing capability of the RS design and improves control during gybes.

While these boards offer outstanding slalom performance, we have also incorporated Exocet's DNA by integrating DDSA (double-density shock absorbers), which provide much-needed comfort and control, vital elements for both PWA races and long-distance sailing.

Notably, the RS 58 boasts a distinct shape within the RS range, drawing inspiration from the renowned Exocet Turboboost 58. The hull plan has been thoughtfully reimagined and updated, involving adjustments to the outline and volume distribution. Tail cutouts have been omitted, prioritizing control over release during turbulent small sail heats. Overall, this board is an ideal choice for high-wind conditions, whether it's on flat water or in challenging environments, providing unparalleled comfort and confidence.

page_title: Windsurf board JP-Australia Super Ride WOOD PRO 2026 - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Windsurf board JP-Australia Super Ride WOOD PRO 2026
short_description: FREERIDE Super Ride is a freeride board designed to combine early planing, stability and smooth control with a lively, sporty feel. It accelerates easily, handles rough water with confidence and delivers the comfortable, fast freeride experience that has defined the Super Ride line from the start.
description:
Board character

The latest generation of the Super Ride focuses on improved stability and control while keeping the board agile and responsive. It offers effortless acceleration, a calm and predictable ride in chop and a smooth, natural feel underfoot. This is a true all-round freeride board that makes high-speed sailing accessible and enjoyable for riders of all levels, with jibes that feel easy and controlled.

Construction

The board is available in two constructions: Wood Pro and ES. Wood Pro is the lighter and more performance-oriented version, offering a crisp and direct feel with paulownia bottom sandwich, parabolic rail reinforcements and Innegra protection in the bow. ES prioritizes durability and everyday usability with paulownia reinforcements, Biax-Glass and a strongly reinforced bow. Both constructions feature multiple strap positions and an ergonomic deck layout.

Shape and details

Super Ride features a wider tail and generous overall width, creating a very stable platform with plenty of planing surface. This shape, combined with an efficient rocker line, allows the board to lift into planing effortlessly and maintain speed even in changing wind conditions. It rides high on the water, reducing drag and improving efficiency at all speeds.

The rail shape has a high apex, which generates extra lift during carving and helps maintain speed for fully planing jibes. The comfortable deck radius supports both inner and more outboard strap positions, while sharp tail edges secure clean water release and boost acceleration. The streamlined outline towards the bow contributes to smooth water flow and keeps the board manoeuvrable and easy to control in chop.

On the water

Super Ride delivers confident and predictable freeriding. It gets going quickly, stays stable at higher speeds and deals with chop effortlessly. Riders can reach impressive speeds without feeling overpowered or unstable. The board keeps its grip in carving jibes and exits the turn with consistency, making manoeuvres smooth and repeatable.

Who is it for

This board suits every freerider looking for comfort, speed and easy handling. It works equally well for riders improving their high-wind skills and for experienced sailors who want a fast and smooth freeride board for a wide range of conditions. Stable, versatile and fun to sail, Super Ride is a reliable choice for lakes, bays and coastal sessions.

Differences in construction: Wood Pro vs ES

Wood Pro is the lighter and more reactive option. Paulownia bottom sandwich, parabolic rail reinforcements and Innegra bow protection provide stiffness and performance, while the Foil-Powerbox makes it suitable for foiling. It is ideal for riders who want a more lively response and a sportier feel.

ES focuses on durability and everyday comfort. It uses paulownia and Biax-Glass reinforcements, a significantly strengthened bow and a standard Powerbox. Slightly heavier but very stable and predictable, it is designed for riders who want a dependable freeride board that will last for many seasons.

page_title: Windsurf board JP-Australia Super Sport WOOD PRO 2026 - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Windsurf board JP-Australia Super Sport WOOD PRO 2026
short_description: FREERACE Super Sport is JP-Australia’s fastest freeride board, combining early planing, high-speed potential and impressive control in a shape that remains comfortable and easy to handle . It accelerates instantly, flies freely above flatwater and chop, and gives recreational sailors access to speeds that normally require full-on slalom equipment.
description:
Board character

Super Sport delivers slalom-level speed in a more user-friendly package. It remains stable, predictable and smooth even when fully powered, offering a direct and connected feel that helps you transfer sail power efficiently into acceleration. Dynamic reaches, fast upwind angles and high-speed carving are all easily accessible, making it a true free-race performer. Despite its race DNA, the board still feels easy to ride, and high-speed jibes are remarkably smooth and controlled.

Construction

The construction is based on a high-quality paulownia wood bottom sandwich with Innegra nose protection and parabolic rail reinforcement. It is designed to provide stiffness, responsiveness and durability for demanding freeride sessions. The setup remains lightweight enough to support rapid acceleration and sensitive control at full speed.

Shape and details

The Super Sport is inspired by JP’s slalom shapes but tuned for performance-oriented freeriders. A compact outline and short length give the board a highly controlled feel, while the parallel midsection maximizes planing surface and provides instant lift into planing.

The concave deck around the mast base lowers the rig’s pivot point, adding stability when powered up. The bottom curve and V-flow, derived from slalom designs, are refined to increase comfort and improve the board’s jibing ability. The long waterline, high riding position and efficient release make the board feel loose and fast on all points of sail.

Thin rails throughout the board’s length provide excellent grip and smoothness in turns, helping the rider enter and exit jibes at speed. Tail cut-outs ensure clean water release and allow easy trim control, while the tail outline and deck shape give strong leverage over the fin for fast acceleration and high-end performance.

On the water

Super Sport planes early, accelerates aggressively and holds speed with minimal effort. It stays composed at high velocity and slices through chop with impressive smoothness. Riders can reach top speeds confidently without the need for slalom-level technique. Dynamic, high-speed jibes feel fluid and natural thanks to the thin rails and stable tail section.

Who is it for

This board is perfect for speed-focused freeriders who want to push their limits without sacrificing comfort. Ideal for flatwater blasting, long coastal runs and fast freeride sessions with friends. It delivers slalom sensations with much easier handling and significantly greater control.

short_description: Hydrofoil SL is an incredibly fast and efficient foil machine - it has performance, power and control for slalom competition . Every rider can find the right size/s and performance needed for their weight and conditions. The stage is set to improve your foil speed! Now featuring updated technology.
description:
Incredible! Faster and faster foil flying! JP's fastest foil boards just got even faster – again! This year the most important performance-enhancing feature of all these boards is their construction: S-TEC gives the boards a new and completely different look and makes the already very light boards even lighter! The boards take-off earlier and are easier to control in the air.

The range has been streamlined to the core sizes: 80, 85 and 88. The main focus has been on efficiency, specifically minimizing resistance and enhancing control in the air. To achieve this, the boards feature a flat nose scoop, a thin rails in the front, and a slightly domed deck at the nose to optimize the airflow. The deck shape in the standing area is flat, with raised pads that extend above the rail, providing consistent leverage towards the foil. Only the main competition size, the 85, now comes in a completely new shape.

Durability remains at the proven level as all important reinforcements remain unchanged and especially through the use of Biax-Carbon. Only items that have no relevance for strength and durability are reduced or abandoned.

The other essential contribution to weight saving comes from the optimized lamination process which not only creates a totally new look, but making the boards up to 300 grams lighter this year and contributes to improved performance.

What a great feature for all HydroFoil Slalom boards!

A distinctive feature of S-TEC technology is the unique pattern resulting from making the composite layers visible. A natural feature is the occurrence of spotty areas of resin and the interconnecting lines of individual layers. By resigning from additional layers of varnish, the board gains absolutely minimal weight.

description:
In this model innovation is a brand-new technology called S-TEC which boosts the boards’ performance to a whole new level and the weight saving is impressive: This generation of Ultimate Wave boards is about 700 grams lighter! The durability maintained at the proven level by replacing the Innegra material with more high-quality S-glass, combined with Biax-Carbon reinforcements and UD Carbon layers underneath the high density PVC. Additionally, the bottom laminate no longer stops at the tuck line but wraps around the rail. Together with the overlapping deck laminate, it acts as an additional stringer along the rails, providing more rigidity and strengthening the rail simultaneously.

This not only creates a totally new look, but being more than a half kilogram lighter delivers a new riding sensation!

One of the most essential features of this shape is the straight center scoop rocker line, paired with a lot more bottom curve along the rails. Werner combines this with an interesting Vee transformation that starts with a moderate Vee in the nose area, changes to a single concave between the straps, and finishes off with a slight Vee at the tail. This results in easy early planing and instant pace, allowing you to ride waves with more speed, confidence, control, and a noticeably more radical style.

A distinctive feature of S-TEC technology is the unique pattern resulting from making the composite layers visible. A natural feature is the occurrence of spotty areas of resin and the interconnecting lines of individual layers. By resigning from additional layers of varnish, the board gains absolutely minimal weight.

The smooth outline and thin, soft rails finish off into a refined swallow tail – a must have feature on this kind of board for maximum grip in high speed turns and ultimate acceleration carving tight turns in smaller surf.

The fin box and standing positions are slightly further back compared to previous models, giving riders the ability to adjust their turns at any time with either front or back foot pressure. This allows for greater control and manoeuvrability on the wave, letting riders truly unleash their skills and creativity from small to giant surf.

name: Windsurf board JP-Australia Magic Wave S-TEC 2026
short_description: WAVE / ALLROUND The JP-Australia Magic Wave is a high-performance all-round wave board that delivers fast early planing , great manoeuvrability and impressive control across almost any wave conditions — from onshore chop to clean down-the-line surf. With the new S-TEC construction , the board is noticeably lighter, more responsive and offers an even smoother, more precise feel on the wave.
description:
Board character

The Magic Wave is designed as a true do-it-all wave board — quick to plane, fast upwind and incredibly fluid regardless of wind direction or wave shape. One of its key strengths is how naturally it adapts to your riding style: it responds extremely well to both front-foot and back-foot riding, keeping full control as you move along the wave. In smaller surf it feels lively and agile, while in bigger conditions it remains predictable and secure.

Construction

This latest generation introduces the S-TEC construction, making the Magic Wave roughly 400 grams lighter than before. Weight savings come from reduced deck coating, smaller EVA pads, a no-paint finish and a refined lamination process. The combination of S-glass, Biax Carbon and UD Carbon reinforcements increases stiffness and durability, while the bottom laminate now wrapping around the rails acts like an integrated stringer. The result is a board that is light, stiff and highly responsive underfoot.

Shape and details

A wider tail with a swallow tail design improves early planing and boosts manoeuvrability, especially in smaller waves. The slightly narrower nose sharpens precision without sacrificing stability. Carefully balanced volume distribution helps punch through whitewater and accelerate onto the plane even in marginal wind. The more centred balance point increases responsiveness, speed in transitions and easier rotations on the wave. A more parallel tail outline adds grip and control for both front- and back-foot styles.

The updated bottom shape — more V up front combined with tuned concave and rocker refinements — enhances comfort in chop and makes tight turns smoother and more controlled.

On the water

The Magic Wave feels fast, dynamic and extremely dependable. Early planing helps you position yourself exactly where you need to be, and the board holds speed effortlessly as you link sections together. It remains stable through transitions, keeps flow in down-the-line surf and accelerates quickly in onshore conditions. Whether carving on a small break or charging powerful walls, the board handles it all with ease and confidence.

Who it’s for

Ideal for intermediate to advanced riders who want one board for nearly every wave day. Light, agile and highly capable, the Magic Wave is perfect as a daily driver for varied conditions or as a versatile contest board for travelling riders.

name: Windsurf sail Duotone Duke 2026
short_description: Duotone Duke is a 5-batten windsurfing sai l designed for riders looking for maximum wind range, control, and versatility . The Light Done Right construction delivers reduced weight without compromising durability. Perfect for bump & jump, freeride, freestyle, and medium wave conditions.
description:
The Duotone Duke marks the return of the brand’s most successful 5-batten sail, re-engineered to meet modern demands. Developed with direct input from real users and windsurfing centers, its core focus is maximum wind range combined with neutral handling in maneuvers.

The Batten Free Center concept, borrowed from the Super_Hero, ensures easy pumping and fast planing while maintaining excellent stability in the upper sail body. This way, the Duke offers the control and wind range advantages of a 5-batten sail but with the lightness and responsiveness more common in 4-batten designs.

Thanks to Light Done Right Construction, overall weight is reduced by 200–300 g without compromising durability. Unlike many lightweight sails, the Duke keeps the same film and XPly thickness, ensuring solid long-term performance backed by a 5-year warranty. The result is a sail that feels not only lighter on the scale but especially in your hands on the water.

A deep profile with a high draft position provides strong planing power and lift, making it easy to get on the plane without excessive pumping. At the same time, the forward draft position allows the sail to completely “switch off” during maneuvers, helping you succeed in tricks and transitions. This draft position also provides excellent lift and control for jumping.

The Duke’s versatility is one of its strongest assets. It excels in bump & jump conditions on a freewave board, works great as a smaller freeride sail, fits both classic and new school freestyle, and handles medium wave sessions with ease – even in gusty or tricky wind. With easy and precise rigging supported by VTS markers and iRocket 2.0 pre-set batten tensions, it’s one of the most user-friendly high-performance sails available.

Duke bridges the gap between freeride, freestyle, and wave, making it a true all-round high-performance sail.

name: Windsurf board JP-Australia Freestyle Wave PRO 2026
short_description: FREESTYLE WAVE / ALLROUND The JP-Australia Freestyle Wave is an all-in-one board that combines freeride speed, wave manoeuvrability and freestyle agility in one balanced shape. With a refined fin trim and updated details, this generation is faster, more responsive and more controlled than ever. description:
Board character

The Freestyle Wave has long been a benchmark in the allround category, known for its balanced feel, comfort and wide usable range. The latest version offers a more compact sensation, increased manoeuvrability and improved top-end control. Whether blasting on flat water, carving tight turns or riding small waves, the board responds quickly and feels lively underfoot.

Construction

Built in JP’s Carbon Innegra construction, the Freestyle Wave combines low weight with excellent strength. Reinforced nose and rail areas increase impact resistance, while the full PVC sandwich improves stiffness. S-Glass stringers stabilise the board at speed, keeping it controlled even in challenging conditions. The result is a durable, lightweight board with a very direct riding feel.

Shape and details

A slimmer nose gives a light and agile feel, while the parallel mid-section provides early planing and stability. The narrow tail maintains control at high speeds and ensures solid grip during carving turns. Footstrap and fin positions allow for versatile tuning: inboard straps and thruster setup for wave-oriented riding, or outboard straps with a single fin for a faster freeride feel.

Up front, a pronounced V with double concaves increases comfort and smooths out choppy water. From the strap area to the tail, the V flattens out, creating a curvy rail line and thinner rails that improve bite and looseness in turns. Reduced centre rocker boosts top speed while maintaining a loose, controlled water position.

On the water

The board gets going quickly, accelerates smoothly and provides excellent control at higher speeds. It feels compact, stable and reactive, making it suitable for blasting, bump and jump sailing or small-wave riding. In turns, the wave DNA becomes clear: the rails grip confidently, transitions are smooth and the board maintains speed effortlessly. It handles rough conditions with ease and remains predictable in both side-shore and side-onshore setups.

Who it's for

Perfect for riders looking for a single, do-everything board. Ideal for intermediate to advanced sailors who want one shape for freeride, bumps, jumps, small waves and freestyle-style manoeuvres. A highly dependable choice for coastal spots, travel and all-round high-wind sessions.

Every detail is designed to enhance competitive foil racing, from acceleration to upwind and downwind angles.

Construction and on-water behaviour

A tighter leech improves aerodynamic efficiency and reduces excess leech movement as foil speeds increase. The widened double-surface luff improves airflow and significantly increases profile stability. Stability and control

Airflow tubular carbon battens are positioned according to the natural sailing rake of the sail, optimizing laminar airflow, facilitating smoother rotation and sharpening acceleration. Carbon leading edge ribs stabilize the upper sleeve where no cambers are used, maintaining a clean, drag-efficient profile through extreme angles of attack.

Racing dynamics

The high aspect design maximizes lift in gusts and improves both upwind and downwind performance. RS:Flight EVO VIII maintains exceptional composure during hard acceleration, rapid course changes and high-speed foiling, making it one of the most advanced foil racing sails available.

short_description: FOIL SLALOM / RACE The JP-Australia HydroFoil Slalom is a dedicated foil racing board built for maximum speed, clean aerodynamics and full control at high velocity. description:
Board character

HydroFoil Slalom focuses on stability, aerodynamic efficiency and high-speed control. The board lifts early, reacts instantly and maintains a steady trim even in heavy gusts. Once airborne, it feels locked-in and predictable, allowing you to push speed without sacrificing control.

S-TEC construction

The HydroFoil Slalom line uses the ultra-light S-TEC construction to reduce weight without compromising stiffness.

Weight savings come from:

- no paint

- reduced anti-slip only in the standing area

- thinner and lighter EVA pads

- precise fibre-by-fibre lamination

The result is up to 300 grams less weight, earlier take-off, sharper response and increased control at racing speeds.

HydroFoil Slalom 85

The 85 model features a fully updated outline, refined rocker line and improved deck aerodynamics.

Key updates:

- earlier lift-off at lower take-off speeds

- sharp V under the front section for a cleaner release

- flatter deck around the front foot for more leverage over the foil

- smoother rail shape around the back foot for better control

- double rear strap plug options for power or control-oriented setups

This is the most versatile size in the range, covering the broadest wind range.

Models 80 and 88

The HydroFoil Slalom 80 and 88 remain unchanged for 2026 and provide the same precise tuning for:

- lighter riders (80)

- heavier riders or larger rigs (88)

Together with the new 85, they create a complete foil slalom toolkit for competition riders.

On the water

The board flies high, stable and clean, with instant acceleration and a secure feel at speed. The large tail cut-outs reduce drag and allow early take-off, while the wide tail provides strong leverage over the foil. Aerodynamic deck shaping smooths airflow and keeps the board balanced in flight. Even during aggressive changes of direction, the trim remains steady and predictable.

Rider profile

A high-performance racing board for advanced riders who demand maximum speed, control and aerodynamic efficiency. Best paired with fast foil race wings and powerful slalom rigs. If your goal is pure foil racing performance, this board is built precisely for that.

short_description: FOIL FREERACE JP-Australia HydroFoil is built for riders who want to combine high speed , stable flight , and easy handling across a wide range of conditions. Board character

The 133 and 155 sizes deliver the most balanced blend of stability, comfort, and foil performance. They take off early, fly with very little effort, and are much easier to control than full-on foil slalom boards. Their biggest advantage is simple: speed comes from ease. The more comfortable the board feels, the faster you go.

Construction

HydroFoil uses a wood-sandwich bottom with paulownia, parabolic rail reinforcements, and an integrated Innegra bow reinforcement. These boards are 100 percent dedicated to foiling and equipped with a reinforced Foil-Tuttlebox, large tail cut-outs, and multiple footstrap positions to match different foil setups.

Shape and details

The boards are narrow and compact, resulting in very low swing weight and a stable, controlled feel in flight. Even volume distribution adds stability during take-off, while extra volume in the bow helps with uphauling on these short boards.

Rounded rails with a defined tuck line reduce drag during occasional touchdowns and instantly bounce the board back into the air. A subtle dome deck in the strap area increases leverage over the foil, improves ergonomics, and makes getting in and out of the straps easier.

Large cut-outs reduce drag, help load the foil during pumping, and promote effortless take-off. The thin profile minimises aerodynamic resistance in flight and keeps the board stable during gusts.

On the water

HydroFoil lifts early, flies smoothly, and remains predictable even at high speed. The stance feels secure and efficient, allowing you to push harder and fully transfer sail power into the foil. The boards excel especially on beam and broad reaches where they maintain high speed with minimal effort.

Who is it for

Perfect for both recreational and advanced foilers who want high-speed flying without the intensity of true foil slalom boards.

name: Windsurf board JP-Australia Magic Move ES 24/25
short_description: New concept for the perfect gybe and early planning Free Move Board. An easy-going, medium-to-high wind machine for freeriding and bump & jump blasting. Ideal for high-wind freeride windsurfing on both flat water and the sea for intermediate and advanced riders.
description:
SMALL MANOEUVRE FREEMOVE

The Magic Move revolutionizes the free move segment requirements, targeting riders seeking a 90 to 110 L sporty board for easy and early planing. This dynamic design offers an exhilarating ride, excelling in speed and maneuverability. Whether riding open ocean swells or tackling coastal waves and reefs, it remains unstoppable. Werner Gnigler praises its versatility and comfort: “Planing gybes and effortless planing guaranteed!”

To introduce another board in the JP line, the questions arise: Why did JP come up with this board, and what are its benefits? Here is how the idea was born:

We have all been there: You have driven hundreds of kilometres South to escape the winter and find a mild spring breeze. You get to the coast and there are some little waves but the wind is extremely light. The Freestyle Wave doesn’t quite cut it as the wind is too light and your freeride board is fun but you’re just blasting in and out and not able to make much out of the little waves on offer.

To address these specific conditions, JP presented the Magic Move. The need for a board tailored to these conditions was identified, and the design brief given to shaper Werner Gnigler was straightforward: 'Develop a new board covering the gap between the Freestyle Wave and the freeride class.'

Right from the beginning, Werner had a clear vision of how to make this a reality, expressing, "I wanted to use the Freestyle Waves as my starting point and adapt a few parameters to achieve the desired improvements." Here they are…

Shape details:

Compared to Freestyle Wave line the Magic Move is slightly longer, wider and equipped with a noticeably wider tail with additional volume. The outline in the mid-section of the board is kept rather parallel, offering a wide planing surface. This in combination with the even volume distribution makes the shapes very stable when non-planing and lifts the rider onto the plane effortlessly with almost no pumping needed.

A unique design feature of these boards is the refined new rail shape: Lifting the apex point along the midsection towards the nose creates the extra required lift. This helps tremendously to maintain speed during the gybe and exit with speed.

Towards the tail the rail shape tapers down and finishes off with a noticeable step rail. This feature allows the use of a wider tail with sufficient volume and still guarantees optimal grip and bite in tight turns when hitting white-water.

The shapes use a flat scoop rocker line designed for early planing and high speed. The pronounced double concave V in the front works like suspension when hitting chop.

Reducing the V towards the area between the foot straps and increasing it again towards the tail disconnects the rail shape from the centre scoop rocker line. This also supports the outstanding mix of performance and manoeuvrability.

The Magic Moves are equipped with various foot strap options and a single fin Powerbox for the perfect customizable set up.

The boards’ Freestyle Wave fins feature a lot of area at the tip, a curvy outline and a smooth, swept back rake angle. Thus, the fin provides a lot of drive and a secure, steady ride in combination with outstanding manoeuvrability.

Summing it up, the boards plane earlier than Freestyle Wave boards and are much better at taking speed through the gybe and staying on the plane during turns. Compared to freeride boards they are more versatile and loose, thus livelier and more fun.

The fins are forgiving in maneuvers and smoothen the ride. The thruster fin setup grants the widest possible range of wave use.

The 2026 version delivers more low-end drive , improved stability and cleaner acceleration while keeping the legendary upper-end control that defines the Combat’s reputation.
description:
Character and purpose

Combat is an all-round wave sail that blends fast acceleration, balanced handling and a remarkably wide wind range. The 2026 update introduces a lighter, thinner batten above the boom, allowing the sail to fill quicker and produce more low-end power. This improves early planing and makes the sail feel lively and reactive even in marginal winds.

Construction and on-water behaviour

The higher aspect ratio introduced in 2024 remains, providing excellent drive upwind and smooth, efficient power delivery down the line. Combat maintains precise aerodynamic stability whether rigged full for light wind or tuned flatter for high-wind control. Its ability to stay composed in gusty conditions continues to be one of its strongest advantages.

Stability and durability

A refined luff curve and enlarged panel layout improve structural stiffness while reducing unnecessary seams and weight. Carefully selected materials create a clean, stable profile that remains dependable in heavy surf or at maximum speed on flat water.

4-batten layout

The four-batten design ensures minimal swing weight, fast depower in manoeuvres and instant response to rider input. The 2026 Combat is more reactive, providing better pop and precise handling during jumps and wave riding.

Constructions and differences between models...

Combat

Versatile and durable, offering the best balance of performance and value:

Combat HD

Heavy Duty construction for riders who prioritise maximum durability:

Combat Pro Fuse

The lightest, most responsive option — the choice for PWA-level performance:

All three versions share the same design, geometry and handling characteristics, differing only in construction materials and weight.

name: Windsurf sail NeilPryde Apex HD Purple/Hot Pink 2026
short_description: POWER WAVE / HIGH WIND CONTROL Neilpryde Apex is a new generation wave sail designed for explosive jumps , a wide wind range and total high-wind control . Built for riders who demand power, stability and precise handling without losing lightness or agility, the Apex delivers exceptional low-end drive , smooth acceleration and a deceptively light feel in the hands.
description:
Character and purpose

Apex was created for sailors who want instant power, rock-solid stability and confidence in extreme or gusty wind, while keeping the sail agile and easy to throw into the air. It is the choice for high-wind jumping and aggressive riding, helping you plane earlier, gain speed faster and boost higher with full control during rotation and landings.

Construction and on-water behaviour

Combining the DNA of the Combat with more bottom-end drive, the Apex accelerates faster and stays more composed when overpowered. A higher aspect ratio and a slightly taller luff improve efficiency both upwind and downwave. The sail fills quickly and smoothly, making early planing effortless and allowing riders to generate immediate lift for big jumps.

Stability and handling

A newly developed luff curve and 3D-designed shaping provide a stiff but not harsh profile. The Apex pumps easily, reaches high top speeds and remains stable even in violent gusts. The sail feels balanced and predictable whether fully powered in side-shore or fighting through difficult onshore surf.

4 / 5 batten layout

Smaller sizes use 4 battens for maneuverability and fast depower. Larger sizes use 5 battens for increased profile stability in stronger winds. This gives each size the ideal weight-to-control ratio across the entire range.

Increased size spacing

Because the Apex has a wider wind range per size, spacing between sizes has been increased. This allows riders to cover more conditions with fewer sails, making travel and quiver organization easier.

Constructions and differences between models...

Apex HD

Apex Pro Fuse

Both constructions share the same Apex geometry and performance characteristics. Only the material package differs.

name: Windsurf sail NeilPryde Fusion HD Hot Pink/Berry 2026
short_description: FREEMOVE / BUMP AND JUMP Neilpryde Fusion HD is a light, stable and easy-handling freemove sail designed for flat water blasting, bump and jump and versatile everyday riding. Positioned between the Apex and the Ryde, it delivers balanced performance with maximum usability.
description:
Character and purpose

Fusion HD is built for riders who want one sail that does everything well. It combines maneuverability with solid speed and works for a wide spectrum of sailing styles, from first jibes to small wave loops. For 2026, the window above the boom has been slimmed down, allowing the lower leech to be crafted from Ultra PE X-Ply for improved durability and reduced weight.

Construction and on-water behaviour

Internally printed laminated panels keep the sail lightweight and durable, while Taffeta in the luff and clew areas spreads loads and increases tear resistance. The Ultra PE X-Ply window provides both visibility and impact strength, and X-Ply reinforcement in the clew and tack improves load distribution. Fusion HD feels light in the hands, maintains a stable profile and provides a predictable amount of power across different conditions.

Stability and control

The 5 batten layout creates a dependable, stable structure with consistent power delivery and excellent high-wind control. The sail accelerates quickly and maintains smooth, comfortable cruising speed, making it ideal for all-day freeride and bump and jump sessions.

Multi use capability

Equally effective on fin or foil, Fusion HD works well on wave, freestyle, freeride or bump and jump boards. It handles small waves, fast carving turns and jumps with ease thanks to its neutral, lightweight feel.

short_description: A professional foil-racing sail for the most demanding, advanced competitors. Designed for aerodynamic excellence and uncompromising speed performance, RS:Flight features 4 cams for incredible profile stability. The fastest, but also the most demanding foil sail in the NeilPryde range.
description:
FOIL RACING. REDEFINED.

Following on from the success of the 2024 Flight EVO, the main areas of improvement for 2025 were aimed at high-end performance and stability.

For 2025, the aspect ratio has been made even higher. The boom length and head width have been reduced to greatly improve high end performance and the leech-twist has also been updated.

There is increased twist in the lower-leech area which gives you unprecedented acceleration in the gusts, while the tighter head keeps the nose trimmed when the power hits, preventing the nose from lifting and allowing you to channel all the extra power directly into speed.

The luff-sleeve width has been further increased to expand the double surface area of the sails profile. This improves efficiency of airflow and, even more importantly, greatly increases profile stability.

All battens are pure carbon tubes, reducing weight and stabilizing the profile of the sail.

name: Windsurf sail NeilPryde V8 Flight 2026
short_description: FOIL FREERACE / TWIN CAM Neilpryde V8 Flight is a super fast , stable and highly controllable foil freerace sail, combining RS:Flight race technology with the ease and handling of the V8. With two cams , a narrow luff sleeve and a lightweight profile, it delivers exceptional speed and control across a 6 to 25 knot wind range.
description:
Character and purpose

V8 Flight is a dedicated foil freerace sail that delivers near-race performance without the complexity of a full slalom foil design. Built around a twin cam setup and a high aspect outline, it takes maximum advantage of every gust while maintaining steady lift and clean flight on long reaches. Its flat profile and tight leech improve acceleration and foil-specific control.

Construction and on-water behaviour

The narrow double luff sleeve simplifies rigging, reduces weight and minimizes water intake during falls. Ultra PE X-Ply in the foot and clew increases durability while keeping the sail responsive. Airflow tubular battens reduce drag and stabilize the aerodynamic profile for smoother, faster foiling.

Foil handling and control

Every movement translates with precision. The two cams create a locked-in foil-specific profile while still allowing smooth, predictable rotation during gybes. The tight leech boosts acceleration and efficiency, enabling riders to choose smaller sail sizes compared to traditional slalom setups.

Stability and dynamics

A high aspect design inspired by RS:Flight enhances upwind and downwind performance, maintaining lift and drive even in gusty or changing conditions. The 2026 iteration adds refined load response and improved stability under foil-specific angles of attack.

page_title: Windsurf board JP-Australia Fun Ride ES 2026 155 - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Windsurf board JP-Australia Fun Ride ES 2026 155
short_description: This shape is designed to let newcomers feel their first planing sensation as early as possible in order get them hooked to the sport instantly! It offers a huge range of use and is the ideal platform for the whole family and friends for their first steps on a windsurf board . On the other hand, its exciting planing potential is a real treat for experienced freeriders.
description:
The length in combination with the parallel outline and the even volume distribution offer stability and outstanding qualities for passive early planing. Novices to planing will find it super easy to get going!

The board covers all kinds of windsurfing levels with its various foot strap plug options.

The Powerbox centre fin is one of the key features of this board: Working like a dagger board, it helps to stay and go upwind for everybody who needs or wants it. The advantage is the low weight compared to a traditional dagger board case. When not needed, the fin is replaced with a cover for smooth water flow and the experienced rider can enjoy the feel and low weight of a normal freeride design!

The deck along the centre is shaped rather flat for maximum stability when not planing. Once moving to a more outboard riding position the ergonomic rail design offers a comfortable stance for an exciting ride. The pronounced V shape, especially in the front enhances the comfort and provides a smoother ride.

Gybing is the other key experience to windsurfing. The forgiving character provided by the wide tail and soft tuck line will help you to master planing manoeuvres.

Comparison with other freeride boards:

The noticeable differences compared to the wider freeride boards of similar volume and range are its length and width: They provide a very different feel and a performance which benefits beginners. Non-planing, the long and narrow hull will stay on track. Sailing in a straight line is easier, while the noses of short, wide boards have a stronger tendency to turn into the wind. As a consequence, less experienced riders will find it more comfortable to get planing thanks to the board’s length. Once planing, the narrow hull will feel less bouncy and not too powerful, yet still quick and easy to control.

The planing experience is the key to becoming addicted to the sport. Sporty for the freerider and easy-going for the whole family - this board is the door opener for future passionate windsurfers.

name: Windsurf board JP-Australia Young Gun Freestyle LXT 2026 65
short_description: Young Gun Freestyle is a high wind shape for advanced kids . It is shorter, and its inserts are tuned to the Youngster’s needs, and therefore is better than the world’s best low volume wave board for adults . It will be fun, and inspiring for the ambitious offspring!
description:
The future starts here! Ambitious kids need the perfect equipment to improve their windsurf skills and to really love the sport. This new shape inspires kids to explore all aspects of windsurfing – maneuver oriented freeriding and especially freestyle. Finally, a compact, low volume design that doesn’t hold back the advanced kid but allows him and her to go wild on the water. The perfect toy for planing, gybing and speeding in control... and obviously first freestyle moves. Designed and built for anyone up to max. ~50 kilos.

Light weight kids use small rigs (actually they don’t have the physical power to hold on to anything big). But too often they struggle with big boards which are too bulky for their sailing level. Once kids feel comfortable in higher winds and know how to get planing and to use the harness, they also need a small board – just like this 65 L board. The also need boards with compact dimensions and adjusted trim which match their small sails. Consequently, the Young Gun Freestyle’s mast box is further back and thus closer to the foot straps for a responsive performance on the water. It also features a reduced stance width between front and rear foot as well as a shorter distance between footstrap plugs for small, narrow feet. It comes with long footstrap plugs for a wider trim range to adjust the stance width to different rider sizes.

Kids grow quickly but that board can stay with them for a while since the trim can be adjusted in a big range. The shape is based on JP's pro model Freestyle board and as such can be used from the improving kid for more freestyle action. It features all the latest shape details, only adjusted in a very compact package and offers stability, early planing and explosive pop, just like the big siblings in JP's range.

FOOTSTRAP SCALE - Your friends and family constantly take your board and change the size of your footstraps? No problem anymore! JP's Footstrap scale allows easy adjustment to the foot size.

page_title: Windsurf sail Loftsails Skyblade 2025 - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Windsurf sail Loftsails Skyblade 2025
short_description: Loftsails Skyblade is a professional windsurfing sail for foil racing. Equipped with Tekcam2 cambers and an extra wide mast pocket, it offers excellent tack stability for great speed performance. Enhanced aerodynamic.
description:
The Skyblade sail is an extension of Loftsails' racing program, developed to maximize the performance of low-drag hydrofoils. This advanced design is tailored for competitive racing and fully adheres to PWA rules.

The Skyblade's design objective is top speed and control during flight. It features radically high aspect ratios and notably wide mast pockets, both contributing to balance and comfort in flight mode. The sail also incorporates a lower foot, reduced vertical shaping, and more aggressive batten angles, which enhance aerodynamics and provide the rig with exceptional stability.

The wide mast pockets require firm tension to maintain efficient airflow. Drawing inspiration from the Racingblade fin slalom program, the Skyblade adopts its unique mast pocket construction. Skyblade mast pockets are constructed with multiple laminate & woven panels. A double-layer stretch-resistance zone is formed with 2-mil quad-axial x-ply (a lightweight material that resists folding memory) and IYU250 woven mast pocket material. This integrated 2-ply tendon extends from head to tack just behind the mast and helps the mast pocket maintain its optimal condition over time.

The downhaul roller is attached to three layers: the two mast pocket sides and the mast pane in between. This setup evenly distributes downhaul loading to all three layers, resulting in a firm, clean, smooth-rotating leading edge. Smooth cam rotation is crucial for maintaining focus during races and provides the balance needed for smooth gybes and transitions.

High trim tension and extreme conditions can take a toll on sail performance over time. To counteract this, the Skyblade is equipped with Metallic Cam Interfaces at all camber inducer contact points, preventing material degradation and ensuring long-lasting performance.

Additionally, all Skyblades are manufactured with Loftsails' signature focus on material durability. The central window, leech, and foot feature x-ply panels, while the bi-ply top panels offer exceptional catastrophic failure and UV resistance, ensuring sail longevity.
