A front wing that makes take-off easier and builds confidence on the water

GA-Foils FREE Front Wings are the most accessible and user-friendly front wings in the GA range. They have been designed to generate lift easily - meaning the upward force that helps raise the board above the water - and to keep flight stable without feeling nervous or twitchy. Easy take-off and calm, stable flight

The FREE series has been tuned to work well already at lower speeds. That is a big advantage for riders learning how to start, trying to get onto foil more easily, or riding in lighter wind. Predictable handling and more comfort

FREE Front Wings offer smooth, predictable handling and good pitch control - meaning the way the foil reacts front to back while flying. These wings also feel very comfortable in relaxed turns and everyday freeride riding.

For learning, progression, and freeride use

description:
The central part of the GA Hybrid system

The GA-Foils Hybrid Aluminum Fuselage is the part that connects the mast, front wing, and rear wing into one complete foil setup. The fuselage has a big influence on how the foil reacts to rider input, how balanced it feels, and whether the setup leans more toward stability or manoeuvrability. In the GA Hybrid system, it plays an important structural role, but also gives you a practical way to tune the foil for different conditions and riding styles.

CNC-machined aluminum construction

The fuselage is made from high-quality aluminum and precision CNC-machined, meaning it is cut with high accuracy for a clean and consistent fit. On the water, that translates into solid stiffness, good alignment, and a reliable connection between the mast and the wings. This kind of construction helps keep the foil feeling predictable and durable through regular use.

A modular system with tuning potential

The Hybrid Aluminum Fuselage is part of the modular GA Foils platform, which means it can be combined with different front wings, rear wings, and mast lengths within the same system. That is a major advantage, because you do not need to replace the entire foil if you want a different ride feel - often it is enough to change the fuselage length or wing combination.

A shorter fuselage usually gives the foil a more agile and lively character. A longer fuselage improves stability, makes the foil feel calmer, and helps with control. That makes the Hybrid system suitable for learning, freeride use, and more dynamic riding depending on the chosen setup.

62 cm - the most agile option, well suited to dynamic wing foiling, carving, and pumping

67 cm - a balanced option with good manoeuvrability and a bit more stability

72 cm - a versatile all-round length with a strong balance of control, glide, and turning ability

82 cm - a more stable option, especially suitable for riders getting into wing foiling

90 cm - optimized for windsurf foiling, where a longer fuselage improves balance and control with a sail

Compatibility

It is compatible with front wings from the Free, HP, and MP series, as well as with 330, 303, MP 210, and MP 180 stabilizers. Both the front wing and rear wing connect to the fuselage using M6 bolts, ensuring a strong and precise fit.

Thanks to this compatibility, you can build anything from a very stable and forgiving setup to one that feels faster, looser, and more performance-oriented.

Outer shell: 100% recycled PU coated PET 450D

description:
Dakine C-2 Harness - windsurfing waist harness

Dakine C-2 Harness is a windsurfing waist harness designed for riders who need stable back support, a secure fit and comfort during longer sessions. It comes with a windsurf-specific spreader bar, so the harness is ready for use with a classic windsurfing hook setup.

The C-2 uses an Adaptive Fit Composite back panel with a Texon® counter/stiffener. This material reacts to heat and pressure, allowing the harness to gradually shape itself to the rider’s body. The result is a more personal fit, fewer pressure points and better load transfer from the sail.

Back support and comfort on the water

The honeycomb mesh reinforced shell helps maintain structural support without unnecessary bulk. It distributes load well when riding hooked in, which is especially useful in stronger wind, on long reaches and during powered windsurfing sessions.

Stable spreader bar and secure closure

The Dual Posi-Lock buckle sliding bar system helps keep the harness closed securely and holds the spreader bar in the right position. The T-Series sliding spreader bar and Freedom Shape spreader bar pad support freedom of movement while keeping the hook controlled during sailing.

Independent primary and secondary power belts let you fine-tune the tension and fit. This makes it easier to achieve solid hold without over-tightening the harness.

Dakine Chameleon Harness - 2-in-1 windsurfing harness

short_description: Dakine T-9 Classic Slider is a windsurfing harness designed for riders who want solid back support, a stable fit and greater freedom of movement thanks to a sliding spreader bar. It comes with a windsurf-specific spreader bar included and is built to deliver comfortable hooked-in sailing with reduced pressure points and better load distribution. The XS size has a 6'‘ spreader bar, the S size has a 10’' spreader bar, and the XL size has a 12'' spreader bar.
description:
What the T-9 Classic Slider is made for

The Dakine T-9 Classic Slider is a windsurf harness with a more supportive and refined construction. It is designed for riders who want a strong lower-back hold combined with more natural body movement while sailing. This model works well for regular windsurfing sessions, whether you ride freeride or with a more performance-focused approach, where harness stability and long-session comfort really matter.

This version uses a sliding hook system that gives a more natural feel while moving and helps the body work more freely when sailing.

Sliding spreader bar and more freedom of movement

One of the key elements of this model is the T-Series Sliding Spreader Bar. This system allows the hook to move more freely instead of keeping your body locked into one fixed position. In practice, that means a more natural range of movement, which is especially noticeable during dynamic sailing, transitions and active sail handling.

For many windsurfers, a sliding hook gives better connection with the rig and a smoother overall feel than a more traditional fixed setup.

Back support and fit

Support comes from the Adaptive Fit Composite Back Panel with Texon® counter/stiffener. This construction is designed to stabilize the back while adapting better to the body shape. That matters because a windsurf harness should support the lumbar area without feeling overly rigid or creating excessive pressure in one spot.

In practice, the T-9 Classic Slider is aimed at riders looking for a more technical fit that stays comfortable through regular use and longer sessions.

Comfort through longer sessions

Dakine uses several solutions here to improve comfort. The Featherweight ES foam molded interior helps keep the harness light, while the Memory Foam pressure point relief zones are there to reduce pressure in the most sensitive areas. This helps the harness sit more naturally on the body and stay comfortable when sailing under load.

The Freedom Shape spreader bar pad also improves comfort at the front of the harness and supports a more natural overall fit.

Fit security and stability

Fit security comes from the Dual Posi-Lock buckle sliding bar system combined with independent primary and secondary power belts. This layout helps stabilize the harness and keep it in place during the session. That is especially important when you want predictable support and less movement while working against the sail load.

A properly secured harness simply works better with the body and does not need constant adjustment on the water.

Construction and durability

The shell uses a Honeycomb mesh reinforced construction to improve overall durability. This matters in a windsurf harness that has to deal with regular load, water exposure and repeated use across many sessions.

The windsurf-specific spreader bar is included in the set, so the harness is ready to use without needing to buy that part separately.

name: DAKINE Chameleon Windsurf Harness with Hook Black
short_description: Dakine Chameleon Harness is a versatile windsurfing harness supplied with a windsurf-specific Push Button spreader bar. Thanks to the removable seat section, it can be worn as either a seat harness or a waist harness, giving you two setup options in one product. Size XS comes with an 8' spreader bar, while size XL comes with a 12' spreader bar.
description:
Dakine Chameleon Harness - 2-in-1 windsurfing harness

Dakine Chameleon Harness is designed for riders who want the flexibility of both seat and waist harness configurations. The seat section attaches at the back with Velcro and can be fully removed, so you can choose the setup that feels best for your riding style, skill level and conditions.

In the windsurf version, the Chameleon comes with a windsurf-specific Push Button spreader bar. It is a practical choice for learning, freeride sessions and recreational windsurfing, especially if you are still deciding which harness type suits you better.

Stable back support and riding comfort

The harness uses a pre-curved P.E.B. inner support structure to help support the back while riding hooked in. This is useful when the pull from the sail is constantly transferred through the harness during longer reaches or stronger wind sessions.

A Featherweight ES foam molded lumbar pad improves comfort around the lower back and helps spread pressure more evenly. This makes the Chameleon a good option for riders who want supportive construction without moving straight into a fully rigid harness.

One harness for different stages of progression

The seat configuration gives a lower hook position and stable hold, which can help during learning and when sailing powered. Once the removable seat section is taken off, the harness works as a waist harness, offering more freedom of movement.

An integrated handle and leash attachment, plus left and right side leash attachment rings, give you flexible setup options. The Single Overlap Power Belt makes the harness easy to tighten and helps keep it stable on the body.

description:
Who the Dakine T-10 Classic Slider is for

The Dakine T-10 Classic Slider is designed for windsurfers who want clear lumbar support without giving up comfort and freedom of movement. It is a harness for riders who sail regularly - from freeride to more dynamic performance-oriented sessions - where harness stability, back support and comfort over long reaches really matter.

The Classic Slider version is a good option for riders who prefer a more natural hip movement and smoother interaction with the sail.

Sliding hook and more natural body movement

One of the key features of this model is the sliding spreader hook setup. This allows the body to move more freely than with a traditional fixed hook system. In practice, it gives a more natural feeling while sailing, better range of motion and more comfort during dynamic maneuvers.

That matters especially in windsurfing, where free movement through the hips and torso has a direct effect on sail control and overall efficiency on the water.

Back support and stability

Dakine uses an Adaptive Fit Composite Back Panel with Texon® stiffener to improve fit and provide additional support through the back area. This construction helps reduce strain on the spine and distributes the load more evenly when sailing hooked in.

The internal back support panel and the independent dual Power Belt system - primary and secondary - further improve overall stability. As a result, the harness stays in place better and does not shift excessively under sail load.

Light construction and comfort over longer sessions

Despite its supportive character, the T-10 does not feel overly heavy. The harness uses lightweight Featherweight ES foam to improve comfort while keeping overall weight down. This makes a real difference when you spend a lot of time on the water and do not want the harness to become tiring after only a few reaches.

Memory Foam pressure relief zones also help reduce concentrated pressure in the most sensitive areas. This leads to more even load distribution and better comfort during long sessions.

Durability and fit

The outer perimeter uses a lightweight and flexible Honeycomb Flex construction. This improves durability while still allowing the harness to flex where needed. The shell is further reinforced with a honeycomb mesh structure, which adds to the overall strength of the harness.

Fit security comes from the Dual Posi-Lock system. This helps improve safety and keeps the harness properly adjusted throughout the session.

Comfort in everyday use

The T-10 also focuses on comfort where the harness contacts the body. The edges are smooth and soft to the touch, which helps reduce rubbing and irritation. This makes a noticeable difference during longer sessions or when wearing the harness with minimal layers underneath.

short_description: Dakine T-10 Classic Slider is a windsurfing harness for riders who want strong back support, a stable fit and greater freedom of movement thanks to a sliding hook system. description:
Who the Dakine T-10 Classic Slider is for

The Dakine T-10 Classic Slider is designed for windsurfers who want clear lumbar support without giving up comfort and freedom of movement. It is a harness for riders who sail regularly - from freeride to more dynamic performance-oriented sessions - where harness stability, back support and comfort over long reaches really matter.

The Classic Slider version is a good option for riders who prefer a more natural hip movement and smoother interaction with the sail.

Sliding hook and more natural body movement

One of the key features of this model is the sliding spreader hook setup. This allows the body to move more freely than with a traditional fixed hook system. In practice, it gives a more natural feeling while sailing, better range of motion and more comfort during dynamic maneuvers.

That matters especially in windsurfing, where free movement through the hips and torso has a direct effect on sail control and overall efficiency on the water.

Back support and stability

Dakine uses an Adaptive Fit Composite Back Panel with Texon® stiffener to improve fit and provide additional support through the back area. This construction helps reduce strain on the spine and distributes the load more evenly when sailing hooked in.

The internal back support panel and the independent dual Power Belt system - primary and secondary - further improve overall stability. As a result, the harness stays in place better and does not shift excessively under sail load.

Light construction and comfort over longer sessions

Despite its supportive character, the T-10 does not feel overly heavy. The harness uses lightweight Featherweight ES foam to improve comfort while keeping overall weight down. This makes a real difference when you spend a lot of time on the water and do not want the harness to become tiring after only a few reaches.

Memory Foam pressure relief zones also help reduce concentrated pressure in the most sensitive areas. This leads to more even load distribution and better comfort during long sessions.

Durability and fit

The outer perimeter uses a lightweight and flexible Honeycomb Flex construction. This improves durability while still allowing the harness to flex where needed. The shell is further reinforced with a honeycomb mesh structure, which adds to the overall strength of the harness.

Fit security comes from the Dual Posi-Lock system. This helps improve safety and keeps the harness properly adjusted throughout the session.

Comfort in everyday use

The T-10 also focuses on comfort where the harness contacts the body. The edges are smooth and soft to the touch, which helps reduce rubbing and irritation. This makes a noticeable difference during longer sessions or when wearing the harness with minimal layers underneath.

description:
Who the Icon Curv is for

This harness is made for windsurfers who ride powered and want stability when loading up the rig—whether you’re into freeride, wave, or freestyle. The focus is on strong back support and a locked-in feel, while still allowing the hip and torso movement you need for dynamic maneuvers.

3D Molded Curv shell: support where it counts

At the core is the redesigned 3D Molded Curv hard shell. A rigid central “spine” provides reliable back support, while the side sections remain more flexible so the harness can wrap naturally around the body and move with you through turns, jumps, and wave riding.

3D Fit Technology: dial in your fit

Comfort that doesn’t soak up water

Hyper_Foam is a viscoelastic foam that shapes to your body for an ergonomic feel without absorbing water like traditional foams. That helps the harness stay lighter and more consistent over long sessions.

Neoprene_Belt: flex and twist for wave & freestyle

The Neoprene_Belt is designed to increase the feeling of flex and twist—especially relevant for wave and freestyle riding where you’re constantly moving and rotating. It helps the harness feel more natural during dynamic riding.

description:
Who the Jewel Curv is for

Jewel Curv is built for windsurfers who ride regularly and want a supportive, secure feel—especially when conditions get stronger and sessions get longer. It’s designed to stay stable under load while still allowing the hip movement you need for active riding.

Female-specific padding and back support

The padding is shaped with female anatomy in mind, aiming for a more natural wrap around the back and hips. In practice, that means more even pressure distribution and fewer pressure points when you’re locked in for long reaches.

3D Molded Curv shell: support where it counts

At the core is the 3D Molded Curv hard shell. A rigid central spine provides reliable back support, while the side sections remain more flexible so the harness can conform naturally to your body and keep you moving freely through turns, jumps, and wave riding.

3D Fit Technology + exchangeable Ergo Pad

3D Fit Technology adds intermediate sizing for a more precise fit. On top of that, the exchangeable Ergo Pad lets you tune the back support shape to match your body and riding style—useful for improving comfort and reducing hot spots during powered sessions.

Spectre Bar 2 + Spectre flaps: stability and load distribution

The Jewel Curv comes complete with the Spectre Bar 2, ION’s spreader bar with a slim outline and an aluminium windsurf hook. It’s designed for even load distribution and precise control. Spectre flaps (removable TPE parts) help prevent the spreader bar from twisting upward, improving stability and responsiveness under load.

Locked-in hold: Internal Flex_Belt + Side padding

The Internal Flex_Belt closure system pulls the harness snug from the inside and adapts to your anatomy. Sewn-in Side padding helps prevent the harness from riding up, keeping the fit stable during active riding and longer tacks.

Comfort that doesn’t soak up water

Hyper_Foam is a viscoelastic foam that shapes to your body for an ergonomic feel without absorbing water like traditional foams. That helps the harness stay lighter and more consistent over long sessions.

description:
Dakine Renegade Harness - lightweight windsurfing waist harness

Dakine Renegade Harness is a windsurfing waist harness for riders who want low weight, solid support and good freedom of movement. In the windsurf version, it comes with a windsurf-specific Push Button spreader bar, so it is ready for use with a classic windsurfing hook setup.

The harness is built around a Curv® Composite flex shell. This material helps disperse the pull from the sail while still flexing with your body during manoeuvres, reaches and changing conditions. The result is stable support without the overly rigid feel of a heavy hard-shell harness.

Support and comfort for dynamic riding

The enhanced-fit pre-curved chassis follows the shape of the back and helps keep the harness in the right position. Its narrow profile improves fit, reduces unnecessary bulk and gives more mobility than bulkier harness designs.

Memory foam pressure point relief zones help reduce pressure in the most sensitive areas. This is useful during longer sessions, when the harness stays loaded for many reaches. The Renegade works well for freeride, freerace and more dynamic windsurfing where control, support and movement all matter.

Secure closure and practical details

Independent primary and secondary power belts let you fine-tune the harness tension and fit. This makes it easier to get a secure hold without over-tightening.

An integrated handle and leash attachment, plus left and right side leash attachment rings, give you extra setup options depending on your gear and preferences.

page_title: Foil mast Gaastra Alu V2 Hybrid - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Foil mast Gaastra Alu V2 Hybrid
short_description: GA-Foils Alu V2 Hybrid Foil Mast is an aluminum foil mast developed for the modular GA Hybrid system. It combines stiffness , durability , and a sensible overall weight, making it a strong option for both wing foiling and windsurf foiling . It is a good choice for riders looking for a solid mast with broad compatibility and a very good price-to-performance ratio.
description:
A versatile mast for the GA Hybrid system

The GA-Foils Alu V2 Hybrid Foil Mast has been designed as part of GA’s modular foil platform. In practice, that means you can combine it with different components and adapt the full setup more easily to your conditions, board type, and riding style. The mast works in both wing foil and windsurf foil configurations, so it makes a lot of sense for riders who want to build one versatile setup or develop it step by step over time.

Aluminum construction - durability and solid stiffness

The mast is made from high-quality aluminum, which gives it a good balance of durability, stiffness, and price. On the water, this kind of construction offers a solid and reliable feel, while also standing up well to regular use. It is a sensible option for riders who want a durable mast without moving into the higher budget of a full carbon setup.

Connection to the fuselage and the board

The mast connects to the fuselage using 3 M6 bolts in 30 mm length. This system provides a strong and precise connection, which is important for the overall stiffness of the foil and for predictable handling on the water.

On the board side, the GA-Foils Alu V2 Hybrid uses an adapter system. Depending on your board box, you can use a Deep Tuttle, Power Box, or US Double Box / Dual Track adapter, which is the most common standard on wing foil boards. Adapters are not included and need to be purchased separately depending on your board.

Available mast lengths

The GA Hybrid Alu V2 is available in several lengths, making it easier to choose the right version for your skill level and local conditions.

45 cm - a good option for learning and shallower spots

65 cm - ideal for early progression and more relaxed riding

75 cm - the most versatile length for mixed conditions

85 cm - for riders looking for more clearance, better control in rougher water, and a more performance-oriented feel

Shorter masts make learning easier and give you more control in the early stages, while longer masts work better once you are riding more confidently and want to unlock more of the foil’s potential.

Compatibility

This mast has been developed for the GA Hybrid Foil system and works with both wing foil and windsurf foil setups. Thanks to the modular design, it can be paired with different fuselages, front wings, and rear wings within the Hybrid range, making future upgrades or setup changes much easier without replacing the whole foil.

page_title: Front wing Gaastra MP - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Front wing Gaastra MP
short_description: GA-Foils MP Front Wings are front foil wings from the Maximum Performance range, built for riders looking for long glide , high speed , and efficient pumping . Thanks to their high aspect ratio design - meaning a longer and narrower wing shape - the MP series works very well for wing foiling, prone foiling, and longer, flowing rides.
description:
A front wing focused on glide and speed

GA-Foils MP Front Wings are designed for riders who want to go faster, glide longer, and ride more efficiently. These wings are built to hold speed well, deliver long glide, and carry better between pumping movements. On the water, this means less effort to stay flying and a smoother overall ride.

What the high aspect ratio shape does

The MP series uses a high aspect ratio shape, which means more span and a narrower outline. This reduces drag in the water, improves glide, and helps the foil keep flying without losing speed too quickly. It is especially useful for pumping, downwind riding, and any kind of foiling where efficiency and flow matter most.

Fast, but still predictable

Even though the MP wings have a more performance-oriented character, they do not feel overly nervous. They still offer good control through turns, stable handling, and predictable behaviour at higher speeds. That matters, because a fast front wing does not have to feel difficult - here you still get smooth carving and a natural foil feel.

Who the MP series is for

This is a good choice for riders who want to move into a more efficient setup and are looking for a wing that offers higher speed, better glide, and stronger pumping performance. The MP series works well for wing foiling, prone foiling, and riding focused on flow and efficiency.

Compatibility

MP Front Wings are compatible with the modular GA foil platform. They can be paired with the GA Hybrid Aluminum Fuselage and GA UHM Carbon Fuselage, as well as the Mach1 / GTX systems. The wings also work with 330 cm2, 303 cm2, MP 210, and MP 180 stabilizers. All front wings in the MP range use M6 bolts, ensuring a secure and precise connection.

name: Rear wing Gaastra MP
short_description: GA-Foils MP Rear Wing 210 / 180 are rear foil wings from the Maximum Performance range, designed to complete more performance-oriented foil setups. They deliver precise control , good glide , and stable handling at higher speeds. This is a strong option for riders who want to fine-tune their foil for speed, flow, and more dynamic riding.
description:
A performance rear wing for modern foil setups

GA-Foils MP Rear Wings have been developed as rear wings for faster, more efficient foil configurations. Their role is to calm down the overall behaviour of the setup, improve foil control, and do it without taking away too much speed or glide. On the water, this means better control at higher speed and a more predictable feel through turns.

What the rear wing does in this kind of setup

The rear wing plays an important role in pitch control, meaning how the foil reacts front to back and how stable it feels through flight. A well-matched stabilizer improves the overall balance of the setup, helps the foil accelerate more smoothly, and keeps the ride feeling more controlled. In the MP range, the profile has been refined to reduce drag while still keeping the control needed for more performance-oriented foiling.

Two sizes, two different characters

The MP Rear Wing series is available in two sizes, making it easier to tune the foil to your preferred riding style.

MP Rear Wing 210 is the more balanced option. It offers a strong mix of stability and responsiveness, making it a good choice for riders who want confident handling, controlled high-speed riding, and predictable behaviour in different conditions.

MP Rear Wing 180 has a smaller surface area, so it creates less drag and gives the foil a faster, more reactive feel. It is the better option for riders looking for maximum glide, quicker acceleration, and more agile turning.

Compatibility

MP Rear Wings are compatible with the GA Hybrid Aluminum Foil and GA UHM Carbon Foil systems. They work with Free, HP, and MP front wings, making them suitable for a wide range of setups depending on riding style and conditions. The stabilizers use M6 bolts, ensuring a secure and precise connection to the fuselage.

page_title: Foil NeilPryde Swift Alu - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Foil NeilPryde Swift Alu
short_description: Feel the ultimate freedom on the water with the versatile Glide Swift Alu foil! Benefits include amazing control, high aspect ratio and a very early take off . The ideal set-up for beginners and experts alike, the Glide Swift impresses in the race world and surprises wave or freestyle riders.
description:
Early lift and easy takeoff

Glide Swift Alu has been designed to make takeoff easier even at low speed. The innovative delta-shaped center section and high aspect wings help the foil lift early and stay flying with less effort. This character works especially well during progression, but it is just as useful when you simply want smooth, comfortable cruising.

Stability and predictable handling

One of the biggest strengths of this model is its very stable behavior on the water. Glide Swift Alu gives the rider a strong sense of control and confidence, making it easier to focus on technique instead of constantly correcting the ride. It responds well to rider input without feeling nervous, which makes it a good match for both beginners and more ambitious riders.

Glide and versatility

By combining traits known from the Glide Swift Carbon with the more versatile character of the Glide Surf HP, this setup offers a broad range of use. Glide Swift Alu works well for relaxed cruising, but it also allows you to progress into more advanced maneuvers and basic freestyle tricks. The long glide and easy speed retention help connect movements more smoothly on the water.

Setup construction

The foil uses the proven Glide Mast Alu and Glide Fuselage Alu, paired with Glide Swift carbon front and back wings. The carbon wings deliver better feel, glide, and responsive handling, while the aluminum structural parts provide solid and consistent performance throughout the setup.

Control in turns

The carbon front wing features a curved leading edge, high aspect outer sections, and a moderate center sweep. This design helps combine maneuverability with control, so the foil remains composed even in harder turns. Low-drag wing tips support smoother flight and help reduce resistance.

Modular system

A major advantage of the NeilPryde platform is its modular design. Front wings and stabilizers from the Glide and Glide Swift ranges are interchangeable and compatible. This gives you more freedom to fine-tune your setup over time and adapt it to your riding style.
features: Maximized efficiency - The innovative Delta center area and the unique High Aspect Wings ensure early and easy lift in combination with an unsurpassed glide and maximum speed. The GLIDE SWIFT is the perfect choice for EVERYONE, from beginners to newcomers.

Fast and stable design - The Carbon Front Wing, which has a curved front edge with outer high-aspect sections and a moderate center sweep, maximizes maneuverability and helps to better control hard turns. The low drag wingtips reduce resistance while reducing the risk of injury.
One wing fits all - All GLIDE HP and GLIDE SWIFT front wings and stabilizers are interchangeable and modular.

name: Rear wing Gaastra HP & FREE
short_description: GA-Foils Rear Wings 303 / 330 are rear foil wings designed for stable , predictable , and more forgiving handling. They work very well in setups focused on learning , progression , and relaxed freeride use, both in wing foiling and windsurf foiling . This is a strong choice for riders who want more control and comfort on the water.
description:
A rear wing focused on stability and easier control

GA-Foils Rear Wings 303 and 330 are stabilizers designed for riders who want their foil to feel calm and predictable. The rear wing plays a major role in the overall stability of the setup and in pitch control - meaning how the foil reacts front to back while flying. A well-matched rear wing helps keep the foil more balanced and easier to manage during take-off, flight, and turns.

A good choice for learning and early progression

A larger stabilizer surface creates more stabilizing force behind the front wing, making the whole setup more forgiving. On the water, this means easier control while learning, a calmer path into foiling, and more confidence during early flights. That is why the 303 and 330 rear wings work very well in beginner-friendly setups and for riders who are still building consistency and foil feel.

Two sizes, two levels of stability

Rear Wing 330 is the more stable option with a larger surface area. It is a good choice for riders taking their first steps into wing foiling, for heavier riders, and for anyone looking for maximum control and easier lift-off at lower speeds.

Rear Wing 303 still offers very good stability, but with a slightly more dynamic and lighter feel. It is a sensible option for progressing riders, freeride use, and setups where you want to keep a strong balance between control and more responsive handling.

Compatibility

Rear Wings 303 / 330 are part of the modular GA Foils system. They fit the GA Hybrid Aluminum Fuselage, GA UHM Carbon Fuselage, as well as the Mach1 and GTX systems. They can be paired with Free, HP, and MP front wings, making it easy to adapt the full foil setup to rider level, conditions, and riding style. The stabilizers use M6 bolts, ensuring a strong and precise connection.

Secure length adjustment

Adjustment is secured by Double Pin Locks mounted on the boom body. The twin-pin system keeps the tail firmly locked at the selected length and helps minimise unwanted movement under load.

Weight and construction

The Unifiber Air Screw Vent is a vent screw for composite boards, equipped with a Torx head and an O-ring seal. It can be used as a replacement for a lost or damaged vent screw or kept as a spare part for trips.

The vent opening allows pressure to equalize between the inside of the board and the surrounding environment. description:
Unifiber Anti-Twist Footstrap Washer Set

Unifiber Cobra Anti-Twist Washer M6 is a two-piece plastic washer designed to reduce footstrap rotation around the mounting screw. It helps keep the strap in the selected position while riding.

The set consists of an upper and lower washer, with the end of the footstrap clamped between them. Protrusions on the underside of the lower washer improve grip against the board pad, helping stabilize the mounting point and reduce twisting of the strap.

Mounting options

For a single-screw mounting setup on each side of the footstrap, both parts of the washer are used — the upper and lower sections.

The footstrap can also be mounted with two screws on each side if the board insert layout and footstrap construction allow it. In this configuration, only the upper washer is used and the lower section is not required.

Contents and compatibility

One set includes one upper and one lower washer for one end of a footstrap. Two sets are required to secure both ends of one footstrap.

Mounting screws are not included.

Before purchasing, check that the washers are compatible with the footstrap and board mounting system. Select the correct screw length while taking into account the total thickness of the mounting setup.

description:
The JP Australia M6 fin screw with PH3 head is a reliable fixing element used in windsurf boards. Made of marine-grade stainless steel, it offers good resistance to saltwater and intensive use. The M6 thread fits most standard fin boxes found in JP boards and many other brands.

Each screw comes with two washers – one rubber and one metal – to improve fit, reduce vibrations and increase durability. The PH3 (Phillips #3) drive allows for quick and easy installation using a standard crosshead screwdriver.

Lightweight Carbon Elite construction

The Unifiber Carbon V2 Inside Tail +60 - Elite is made from high-grade pre-preg carbon and designed to deliver maximum stiffness at minimal weight.

Compact profile for wave and foil racing

The inner boom tail width is 15.5 cm. This provides enough clearance for the sail while maintaining a compact and controlled feel.

The geometry is well suited to wave sailing and foil racing in stronger winds, where quick rig response, control through transitions and a stable connection to the sail are important.

Pulley outhaul system

It allows smooth and precise outhaul adjustment, making it easier to fine-tune sail tension as wind strength and sailing conditions change.

Inside Tail construction

The Inside Tail design means the boom tail slides inside the compatible boom body.

The tube diameter is 21 mm. This slim construction helps keep weight low at the rear of the boom while maintaining high stiffness.

Configure Me

The Carbon V2 Inside Tail +60 - Elite is part of the Unifiber Configure Me modular boom system. Individual compatible components can be replaced, renewed or upgraded without replacing the complete boom.

The boom tail works with selected Carbon HD Monocoque V2 and Carbon Elite Monocoque V2 boom bodies.

Carbon HD Monocoque V2 160-220 Inside Wide Tail

Carbon Elite Monocoque V2 160-220 Inside Wide Tail

Secure adjustment

The adjustment range is +60 cm.

Length adjustment is secured by Double Pin Locks mounted on the boom body. The twin-pin system keeps the boom tail firmly locked at the selected position and helps minimise unwanted movement under load.

name: Unifiber Carbon V2 Modular Body Inside Wide Tail 170 - HD
short_description: Unifiber HD Carbon V2 Body 170 Inside Wide Tail is a carbon windsurfing boom body made from a 70% pre-preg carbon lay-up, with a 27 x 29 mm grip and monocoque construction. It is part of the Configure Me system and offers a stiffer, more durable alternative to standard aluminium boom bodies.
description:
HD carbon boom body for higher loads

The Unifiber HD Carbon V2 Body 170 Inside Wide Tail is designed for building a stiff and durable boom within the Unifiber Configure Me system.

The body uses a 70% pre-preg carbon HD - Heavy Duty lay-up. This construction provides a strong balance of stiffness, durability and price, while delivering noticeably more direct feedback than aluminium designs.

27 x 29 mm grip

The body features an ergonomic oval grip with a 27 x 29 mm cross-section.

This profile sits comfortably in the hand during longer sessions while maintaining the structural stiffness required from a 170-size boom body.

Inside Wide Tail

The body is designed for use with a compatible Inside Wide Tail.

In this configuration, the boom tail slides inside the boom body. The result is a compact and direct feel suited to modern freeride and freerace sails.

Double Pin Locks are mounted on the boom body and securely hold the compatible tail at the selected length.

70% pre-preg carbon HD

The Heavy Duty construction uses a 70% pre-preg carbon lay-up and is designed with durability and resistance to regular high loads in mind.

High stiffness reduces boom arm flex and improves feedback from the sail. This gives the rig a more stable and predictable feel through gusts and during high-speed sailing.

Monocoque Boom Body

The body uses monocoque construction with continuous boom arms and 2.2 mm tube walls.

This improves load distribution and supports overall structural stiffness. The reinforced tube walls increase durability, but also make the HD version slightly heavier than the Elite series.

The boom body weighs 1.93 kg.

High-density EVA

High-density EVA is used on the front arch.

This area is particularly exposed to abrasion during regular use, so the more durable grip material helps improve long-term wear resistance.

Only compatible with Modular Boom Head

The HD Carbon V2 Body 170 Inside Wide Tail is compatible exclusively with the Unifiber Modular Boom Head.

The head can be fitted without tools, making it quick to transfer between compatible Configure Me boom bodies.

Configure Me

The body is part of the Unifiber Configure Me modular system.

The boom head, body and tail can be selected and replaced separately. This allows one boom head to be used with several different bodies, individual worn components to be replaced, and the setup to be adapted more easily to different sails.

page_title: Unifiber Carbon V2 Modular Body Inside Wide Tail 170 - Elite - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Unifiber Carbon V2 Modular Body Inside Wide Tail 170 - Elite
short_description: Unifiber Elite Carbon V2 Body 170 Inside Wide Tail is a full-carbon windsurfing boom body made from 100% pre-preg carbon, with a 27 x 29 mm grip and monocoque construction. It is designed for the Configure Me system and works with the Modular Boom Head and a compatible Inside Wide Tail
description:
Elite carbon boom body 170

The Unifiber Elite Carbon V2 Body 170 Inside Wide Tail is a standalone boom body designed for building a light and very stiff setup within the Unifiber Configure Me system.

The body is made from 100% high-grade pre-preg carbon. This construction reduces flex under heavy loads and provides direct power transfer between rider and sail.

Slim 27 x 29 mm grip

The body uses an oval 27 x 29 mm grip. The extended thinner grip section helps keep your hands clear of the oversized rear section when gybing.

This is particularly useful during dynamic sailing, where quick hand movement across the boom can make manoeuvres smoother and more controlled.

Inside Wide Tail

The body is designed for use with a compatible Inside Wide Tail.

In this setup, the boom tail slides inside the boom body. The construction provides a compact, direct feel and works well with modern freeride and freerace sails.

Double Pin Locks are mounted on the boom body and securely hold the tail at the selected length.

100% pre-preg carbon

The full-carbon construction is focused on high stiffness and low weight.

Reduced boom arm flex helps the sail maintain a stable profile during strong gusts and high-speed sailing. This becomes especially important with larger sails, where boom loads are considerably higher.

Monocoque Boom Body

The body uses monocoque construction with continuous boom arms and 2 mm tube walls.

This improves load distribution and provides high stiffness at an operating weight of 1.69 kg.

High-density EVA

High-density EVA is used on the front arch.

This area is particularly exposed to abrasion during regular use, so the more durable grip material helps improve long-term wear resistance.

Only compatible with Modular Boom Head

The Elite Carbon V2 Body 170 Inside Wide Tail is compatible exclusively with the Unifiber Modular Boom Head.

The head can be installed without tools, making it quick to transfer between compatible Configure Me boom bodies.

Configure Me

The body is part of the Unifiber Configure Me modular system.

The boom head, body and tail can be selected separately, allowing individual components to be replaced without buying a complete new boom. The same boom head can also be used with several compatible bodies.

This is practical when expanding a quiver, storing equipment or travelling.

page_title: Unifiber Modular Boom Head for RDM & SDM - Essentials - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Unifiber Modular Boom Head for RDM & SDM - Essentials
short_description: The newly developed Unifiber® boom head (patent pending). Truly plug and play. Compatible with all masts. Optimal performance for all riders from junior to PWA professionals.
description:
After hundreds of hours R&D we present a new standard in solid and secure boom head connection. Combine with any “Configure Me” Unifiber Boom Body for a perfect connection to all masts (SDM or RDM).

The two collars that close around the mast evenly distribute all the forces of the rig without point loading the mast. Original installed Clamcleats® make it easy to fine-tune the tension of each lever individually so that the boom head wraps perfectly around the mast. Designed to function in harmony with the forces generated under load. Play is minimized, and the mast is permitted to maintain its natural bend curve.

Riders of all levels will appreciate the immediate and direct feel.

Conveniently switch between the SDM and RDM adapters. "Direct fit" geometry allows quick, easy, hassle-free attachment.

Benefit from the advantages of a modular boom system. The modular boom head fits all "Configure Me" Boom Bodies. Swapping the boom head is effortless and takes seconds - no tools required. For example: with 1 boom head, 3 boom bodies and 1 tail you have 3 high-performance booms of different sizes. This makes the most of your available budget, storage space, baggage allowance. Direct fit and twist locks the boom head to the body. Professional users seeking maximum possible stiffness may choose to install the optional "performance bolts" (only supplied with HD and Elite models). Performance bolts increase stiffness by approximately 10% and take about a minute to fit using a hex key.

Be part of the future! Enjoy light weight and absolute performance. Benefit from "Configure Me" modular options to combine, renew and upgrade components as required.

page_title: Cobra Plastic Anti-Twist Washer M6 Set - Price, Reviews - EASY-surfshop
name: Cobra Plastic Anti-Twist Washer M6 Set
short_description: Unifiber Cobra Anti-Twist Washer M6 is a two-piece plastic washer designed to reduce footstrap rotation around the mounting screw. It helps keep the strap in the selected position while riding.
description:
Unifiber Anti-Twist Footstrap Washer Set

Unifiber Cobra Anti-Twist Washer M6 is a two-piece plastic washer designed to reduce footstrap rotation around the mounting screw. It helps keep the strap in the selected position while riding.

The set consists of an upper and lower washer, with the end of the footstrap clamped between them. Protrusions on the underside of the lower washer improve grip against the board pad, helping stabilize the mounting point and reduce twisting of the strap.

Mounting options

For a single-screw mounting setup on each side of the footstrap, both parts of the washer are used — the upper and lower sections.

The footstrap can also be mounted with two screws on each side if the board insert layout and footstrap construction allow it. In this configuration, only the upper washer is used and the lower section is not required.

Contents and compatibility

One set includes one upper and one lower washer for one end of a footstrap. Two sets are required to secure both ends of one footstrap.

Mounting screws are not included.

Before purchasing, check that the washers are compatible with the footstrap and board mounting system. Select the correct screw length while taking into account the total thickness of the mounting setup.

name: Unifiber Carbon V2 Inside Wide Tail +50 - Elite
short_description: Unifiber Carbon V2 Inside Wide Tail +50 - Elite is a lightweight carbon boom tail for deeper-profile sails. High-grade pre-preg carbon construction, a 14.5 cm inner width and pulley system provide high stiffness, low weight and precise outhaul adjustment.
description:
Light and stiff Elite boom tail

The Unifiber Carbon V2 Inside Wide Tail +50 - Elite is made from high-grade pre-preg carbon and designed to deliver high stiffness at minimal weight.

The construction reduces flex in the rear section of the boom under load and helps the sail maintain a stable profile. Its low weight also reduces swing weight, contributing to more direct and controlled handling during manoeuvres.

Wider profile for deeper sails

The inner boom tail width is 14.5 cm. The wider outline provides additional clearance for modern sails with deeper profiles.

This extra space helps reduce contact between the sail and boom and supports the intended sail shape under higher loads.

Pulley system

The boom tail features a pulley system at the clew for smooth and precise outhaul adjustment.

It can be configured with an adjustable outhaul system of your choice, allowing the setup to be matched to your preferred trimming method.

Inside Tail construction

The Inside Tail design means the boom tail slides inside a compatible boom body.

The tail diameter is 27 mm. Combined with the lightweight Elite carbon construction, this helps keep rear-end weight low and improves overall rig control.

Configure Me

The Carbon V2 Inside Wide Tail +50 - Elite is part of the Unifiber Configure Me modular boom system. Compatible components can be replaced, renewed or upgraded individually without replacing the complete boom.

The boom tail can therefore be used as a replacement part or to modify the configuration of a compatible boom.

Secure adjustment

The adjustment range is +50 cm.

Double Pin Locks are mounted on the boom tail. The twin-pin system securely holds the selected length and helps minimise unwanted movement under load.

Low weight

The boom tail weighs 0.61 kg. Low weight is one of the key advantages of the Elite range, helping reduce swing weight and improve rig control during manoeuvres and direction changes.
